    actual_identity = [
        (
            row["ordinal"], row["config"], row["target"],
            row["sourceOperand"],
        )
        for row in rows
    ]
    if actual_identity != expected_identity:
        raise ContractError("compile input/sourceOrder mapping drift")
    for row, (_, _, path) in zip(rows, operands, strict=True):
        data = snapshot_bytes(path)
        require_regular(path)
        if (
            path.resolve(strict=True) != path
            or row["bytes"] != len(data)
            or row["sha256"] != sha(data)
        ):
            raise ContractError("compile input changed during production")
    return digest


def select_swift_record(
    description: dict[str, object], target: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, object]]:
    commands = description.get("swiftCommands")
    if not isinstance(commands, dict):
        raise ContractError("description swiftCommands schema")
    matches = [
        (key, value)
        for key, value in commands.items()
        if isinstance(key, str)
        and isinstance(value, dict)
        and value.get("moduleName") == target
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ContractError("swiftCommands record closure")
    key, record = matches[0]
    required = {
        "executable", "importPath", "moduleName", "otherArguments", "sources"
    }
    if not required <= set(record):
        raise ContractError("swiftCommands required field closure")
    return key, record


REMOVALS: dict[str, int] = {
    "-incremental": 0,
    "-enable-batch-mode": 0,
    "-serialize-diagnostics": 0,
    "-parseable-output": 0,
    "-whole-module-optimization": 0,
    "-emit-objc-header": 0,
    "-index-store-path": 1,
    "-num-threads": 1,
    "-emit-objc-header-path": 1,
}
OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES = (
    "-emit-", "-index-", "-serialize-diagnostics", "-save-temps",
    "-driver-batch", "-num-threads", "-whole-module-optimization",
)


def remove_closed_flags(arguments: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]]]:
    retained: list[str] = []
    removed: list[list[str]] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(arguments):
        token = arguments[index]
        if token in REMOVALS:
            width = REMOVALS[token]
            if index + width >= len(arguments):
                raise ContractError("missing removed-flag operand")
            removed.append(arguments[index:index + width + 1])
            index += width + 1
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r"-j[0-9]+", token):
            if token != "-j10":
                raise ContractError("unknown scheduling flag")
            removed.append([token])
            index += 1
            continue
        if token.startswith(OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES):
            raise ContractError("unknown output/scheduling flag")
        retained.append(token)
        index += 1
    return retained, removed


def singleton_value(argv: list[str], flag: str) -> str:
    positions = [index for index, token in enumerate(argv) if token == flag]
    if len(positions) != 1 or positions[0] + 1 >= len(argv):
        raise ContractError(f"{flag} singleton")
    return argv[positions[0] + 1]


def _pairs(argv: list[str], flags: set[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    return [
        [token, argv[index + 1]]
        for index, token in enumerate(argv[:-1])
        if token in flags
    ]


def _conditionals(argv: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    rows: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(argv):
        token = argv[index]
        if token == "-D":
            if index + 1 >= len(argv):
                raise ContractError("dangling -D")
            rows.append(argv[index + 1])
            index += 2
        elif token.startswith("-D") and len(token) > 2:
            rows.append(token[2:])
            index += 1
        else:
            index += 1
    return rows


def semantic_signature(argv: list[str], sources: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    source_set = set(sources)
    return {
        "module": singleton_value(argv, "-module-name"),
        "target": singleton_value(argv, "-target"),
        "sdk": singleton_value(argv, "-sdk"),
        "optimization": [
            token for token in argv
            if token in {"-Onone", "-O", "-Osize", "-Ounchecked"}
        ],
        "conditionals": _conditionals(argv),
        "imports": _pairs(argv, {"-I", "-F", "-L", "-vfsoverlay"}),
        "plugins": _pairs(argv, {
            "-plugin-path", "-external-plugin-path",
            "-in-process-plugin-server-path", "-load-plugin-executable",
            "-load-plugin-library",
        }),
        "xcc": [
            argv[index + 1]
            for index, token in enumerate(argv[:-1]) if token == "-Xcc"
        ],
        "sourceOrder": [token for token in argv if token in source_set],
        "parseAsLibraryCount": argv.count("-parse-as-library"),
        "xfrontend": _pairs(argv, {"-Xfrontend"}),
    }


def transform_record(
    record: dict[str, object], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]], list[list[str]]]:
    executable = record.get("executable")
    module = record.get("moduleName")
    import_path = record.get("importPath")
    sources = record.get("sources")
    arguments = record.get("otherArguments")
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in (executable, module, import_path)):
        raise ContractError("driver record scalar schema")
    if module != target or not isinstance(sources, list) or not all(
        isinstance(item, str) for item in sources
    ):
        raise ContractError("driver record source schema")
    if not isinstance(arguments, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in arguments):
        raise ContractError("driver record argument schema")
    retained, removed = remove_closed_flags(arguments)
    positions = [index for index, token in enumerate(retained) if token == "-module-cache-path"]
    if len(positions) != 1 or positions[0] + 1 >= len(retained):
        raise ContractError("Swift module-cache closure")
    swift_index = positions[0] + 1
    old_swift = retained[swift_index]
    new_swift = str(output / "cache" / config / target / "swift")
    retained[swift_index] = new_swift
    xcc_cache = [
        index + 1 for index, token in enumerate(retained[:-1])
        if token == "-Xcc" and retained[index + 1].startswith("-fmodules-cache-path=")
    ]
    if len(xcc_cache) > 1:
        raise ContractError("Clang module-cache closure")
    new_clang = str(output / "cache" / config / target / "clang")
    rewrites = [["-module-cache-path", old_swift, new_swift]]
    if xcc_cache:
        position = xcc_cache[0]
        old_clang = retained[position].split("=", 1)[1]
        retained[position] = "-fmodules-cache-path=" + new_clang
        rewrites.append(["-fmodules-cache-path", old_clang, new_clang])
    else:
        retained.extend(["-Xcc", "-fmodules-cache-path=" + new_clang])
        rewrites.append(["-fmodules-cache-path", "ABSENT", new_clang])
    command = [
        executable, "-typecheck", "-dump-ast", "-dump-ast-format", "json",
        "-module-name", module, "-I", import_path, *sources, *retained,
    ]
    validate_base(command, list(sources), output, config, target)
    return command, removed, rewrites


def _validate_caches(signature: dict[str, object], argv: list[str], output: Path) -> None:
    if not contained(output, Path(singleton_value(argv, "-module-cache-path"))):
        raise ContractError("Swift cache containment")
    clang = [
        str(value).split("=", 1)[1]
        for value in signature["xcc"]  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        if str(value).startswith("-fmodules-cache-path=")
    ]
    if len(clang) != 1 or not contained(output, Path(clang[0])):
        raise ContractError("Clang cache containment")


def validate_base(
    argv: list[str], sources: list[str], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> None:
    prefix = [
        argv[0], "-typecheck", "-dump-ast", "-dump-ast-format", "json",
        "-module-name", target,
    ]
    if argv[:len(prefix)] != prefix:
        raise ContractError("base command prefix")
    signature = semantic_signature(argv, sources)
    if signature["sourceOrder"] != sources or signature["module"] != target:
        raise ContractError("base source/module drift")
    if ("DEBUG" in signature["conditionals"]) != (config == "debug"):
        raise ContractError("base DEBUG drift")
    if any(token.startswith(OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES) for token in argv):
        raise ContractError("base output/scheduling residue")
    _validate_caches(signature, argv, output)


def validate_frontend(
    argv: list[str], sources: list[str], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> None:
    if (
        len(argv) < 8 or not argv[0].endswith("/swift-frontend")
        or argv[1:3] != ["-frontend", "-dump-ast"]
    ):
        raise ContractError("frontend prefix")
    if argv.count("-primary-file") != 1:
        raise ContractError("frontend primary count")
    primary = singleton_value(argv, "-primary-file")
    if primary not in sources:
        raise ContractError("frontend primary source")
    if singleton_value(argv, "-dump-ast-format") != "json":
        raise ContractError("frontend AST JSON mode")
    if singleton_value(argv, "-o") != "-":
        raise ContractError("frontend stdout routing")
    forbidden = {
        "-emit-module", "-emit-object", "-emit-module-path",
        "-index-store-path", "-serialize-diagnostics",
        "-serialize-diagnostics-path", "-incremental", "-enable-batch-mode",
        "-parseable-output",
    }
    if forbidden.intersection(argv):
        raise ContractError("mutating frontend output flag")
    if (
        any(token.startswith(OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES) for token in argv)
        or any(re.fullmatch(r"-j[0-9]+", token) for token in argv)
    ):
        raise ContractError("unknown frontend output/scheduling flag")
    signature = semantic_signature(argv, sources)
    if signature["sourceOrder"] != sources or signature["module"] != target:
        raise ContractError("frontend source/module drift")
    if ("DEBUG" in signature["conditionals"]) != (config == "debug"):
        raise ContractError("frontend DEBUG drift")
    _validate_caches(signature, argv, output)


def parse_dryrun(
    stdout: bytes, sources: list[str], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> list[list[str]]:
    try:
        lines = stdout.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
        raise ContractError("dry-run stdout encoding") from error
    if not lines or any(not line for line in lines):
        raise ContractError("dry-run line closure")
    jobs: list[list[str]] = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            argv = shlex.split(line, posix=True)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ContractError("dry-run command quoting") from error
        validate_frontend(argv, sources, output, config, target)
        jobs.append(argv)
    primaries = [singleton_value(argv, "-primary-file") for argv in jobs]
    if primaries != sources:
        raise ContractError("dry-run primary closure/order")
    return jobs


def target_for_exact_path(path: str) -> str:
    validate_exact_path(path)
    matches = [
        target for target in TARGETS if path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ContractError("exact path target closure")
    return matches[0]

@dataclass
class FailureContext:
    stage: str = "bootstrap"
    config: str = ""
    target: str = ""
    exact_path: str = ""


CONTEXT = FailureContext()


def deterministic_environment(output: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    values = dict(os.environ)
    values.update({
        "LC_ALL": "C", "LANG": "C", "TZ": "UTC",
        "TMPDIR": str(output / "tmp"),
        "SWIFT_MODULECACHE_PATH": str(output / "cache" / "environment-swift"),
        "CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH": str(output / "cache" / "environment-clang"),
    })
    return values


def _runtime_directory_identity(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]:
    descriptor = _open_directory_from_root(path)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
            raise ContractError("runtime descriptor is not directory")
        return _directory_identity(info)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def validate_runtime_directories(
    output: Path,
    expected: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]] | None = None,
) -> dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]]:
    """Validate non-authority cache/TMPDIR topology at process boundaries."""
    require_directory(output)
    observed: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]] = {}
    for leaf in ("cache", "tmp"):
        root = output / leaf
        require_directory(root)
        if root.resolve(strict=True) != root or not contained(output, root):
            raise ContractError("runtime root containment drift")
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            directory = stack.pop()
            require_directory(directory)
            observed[directory] = _runtime_directory_identity(directory)
            if directory != root and not contained(root, directory):
                raise ContractError("runtime directory escape")
            for item in os.scandir(directory):
                path = Path(item.path)
                if item.is_symlink():
                    raise ContractError("symlink in runtime directory")
                if item.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                    require_directory(path)
                    if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
                        raise ContractError("runtime directory resolution drift")
                    stack.append(path)
                elif not item.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
                    raise ContractError("special runtime directory entry")
    if expected is not None and any(
        observed.get(path) != identity for path, identity in expected.items()
    ):
        raise ContractError("runtime directory identity changed across subprocess")
    return observed


@dataclass
class RuntimeDirectoryLease:
    descriptors: dict[Path, int]
    identities: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]]

    def verify(self, output: Path) -> None:
        validate_runtime_directories(output, {
            path: identity for path, identity in self.identities.items()
            if path == output / "cache" or path == output / "tmp"
            or output / "cache" in path.parents or output / "tmp" in path.parents
        })
        for path, descriptor in self.descriptors.items():
            if _directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor)) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("held runtime directory descriptor drift")
            if _runtime_directory_identity(path) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("runtime directory pathname replacement")

    def close(self) -> None:
        for descriptor in self.descriptors.values():
            os.close(descriptor)
        self.descriptors.clear()


@dataclass
class AuthorityDirectoryLease:
    descriptors: dict[Path, int]
    identities: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]]

    @classmethod
    def acquire(cls, *paths: Path) -> "AuthorityDirectoryLease":
        lease = cls({}, {})
        try:
            for path in paths:
                lease.add(path)
            return lease
        except BaseException:
            lease.close()
            raise

    def add(self, path: Path) -> None:
        if path in self.descriptors:
            raise ContractError("duplicate authority directory anchor")
        require_directory(path)
        descriptor = _open_directory_from_root(path)
        identity = _directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor))
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(identity[2]):
            os.close(descriptor)
            raise ContractError("authority anchor is not directory")
        self.descriptors[path] = descriptor
        self.identities[path] = identity

    def verify(self) -> None:
        for path, descriptor in self.descriptors.items():
            if _directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor)) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("held authority directory descriptor drift")
            if _runtime_directory_identity(path) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("authority directory pathname replacement")

    def close(self) -> None:
        for descriptor in self.descriptors.values():
            os.close(descriptor)
        self.descriptors.clear()


def hold_runtime_directories(repo: Path, output: Path) -> RuntimeDirectoryLease:
    observed = validate_runtime_directories(output)
    for path in (repo, output):
        require_directory(path)
        observed[path] = _runtime_directory_identity(path)
    descriptors: dict[Path, int] = {}
    try:
        for path in observed:
            descriptors[path] = _open_directory_from_root(path)
        lease = RuntimeDirectoryLease(descriptors, observed)
        lease.verify(output)
        return lease
    except BaseException:
        for descriptor in descriptors.values():
            os.close(descriptor)
        raise


def _json_worker(send: object, raw: bytes, expected_filename: str) -> None:
    connection = send
    try:
        value = strict_json(raw, dictionary=True)
        ok = isinstance(value, dict)
        if expected_filename:
            ok = ok and (
                value.get("_kind") == "source_file"
                and value.get("filename") == expected_filename
                and value.get("compiler_version") == AST_COMPILER_VERSION
                and isinstance(value.get("items"), list)
            )
        connection.send({"ok": ok, "kind": type(value).__name__})
    except BaseException as error:
        connection.send({"ok": False, "kind": type(error).__name__})
    finally:
        connection.close()


def parse_json_dictionary_isolated(path: Path, expected_filename: str = "") -> None:
    raw = snapshot_bytes(path)
    context = multiprocessing.get_context("fork")
    receive, send = context.Pipe(duplex=False)
    process = context.Process(
        target=_json_worker, args=(send, raw, expected_filename)
    )
    process.start()
    send.close()
    try:
        payload = receive.recv()
    except EOFError as error:
        process.join()
        raise ContractError("JSON worker exited without evidence") from error
    finally:
        receive.close()
    process.join()
    if (
        process.exitcode != 0 or not isinstance(payload, dict)
        or payload.get("ok") is not True or payload.get("kind") != "dict"
    ):
        raise ContractError("AST is not a fully parseable JSON dictionary")


ARTIFACT_FIELDS = {
    "ordinal", "artifactID", "role", "relativePath", "fileType", "bytes",
    "sha256",
}
ARTIFACT_ROLE_COUNTS = {
    "process-stdout": 95,
    "process-stderr": 95,
    "process-exit": 95,
    "swiftpm-description": 2,
    "swift-command-record": 6,
    "frontend-dryrun-jobs": 6,
}
COMMAND_FIELDS = {
    "schema", "ordinal", "stage", "config", "target", "exactPath",
    "argv", "argvNULSHA256", "exitCode", "stdout", "stderr", "exit",
}
CONFIG_FIELDS = {
    "config", "target", "recordKey", "recordArtifact", "recordSHA256",
    "sourceOrder", "baseArgv", "baseArgvNULSHA256",
    "baseSemanticSignature", "removed", "rewritten", "dryrunArtifact",
    "dryrunPrimaryCount", "dryrunArgvNULSHA256", "selectedCount",
}
JOB_FIELDS = {
    "ordinal", "jobID", "config", "target", "exactPath", "primarySource",
    "sourceBytes", "sourceSHA256", "argv", "argvNULSHA256",
    "semanticSignature", "commandOrdinal", "stdout", "stderr", "exit",
}
PROGRESS_FIELDS = (
    "ordinal", "jobID", "config", "target", "exactPath", "sourceBytes",
    "sourceSHA256", "commandSHA256", "exit", "stdoutBytes", "stdoutSHA256",
    "stderrBytes", "stderrSHA256", "validJSON", "jsonKind",
)


def validate_artifact_rows(
    output: Path, rows: list[dict[str, object]]
) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT:
        raise ContractError("artifact count")
    indexed: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    role_counts = {role: 0 for role in ARTIFACT_ROLE_COUNTS}
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(rows):
        if (
            set(row) != ARTIFACT_FIELDS
            or type(row.get("ordinal")) is not int
            or row.get("ordinal") != ordinal
        ):
            raise ContractError("artifact row schema/order")
        role = row.get("role")
        relative = row.get("relativePath")
        size = row.get("bytes")
        if (
            not isinstance(role, str) or role not in role_counts
            or not isinstance(relative, str) or relative in indexed
            or not isinstance(size, int) or isinstance(size, bool) or size < 0
            or row.get("fileType") != "regular"
        ):
            raise ContractError("artifact row type/closure")
        safe_relative(relative)
        path = output / relative
        require_regular(path)
        expected_id = sha(
            b"P1BTerminalASTArtifactV2\0" + role.encode() + b"\0"
            + relative.encode()
        )
        if (
            path.resolve(strict=True) != path or not contained(output, path)
            or row.get("artifactID") != expected_id
        ):
            raise ContractError("artifact identity/hash/containment")
        require_file_snapshot(path, size, str(row.get("sha256")))
        indexed[relative] = row
        role_counts[role] += 1
    if role_counts != ARTIFACT_ROLE_COUNTS:
        raise ContractError("artifact role arithmetic")
    require_evidence_tree_closure(output, set(indexed))
    walk_regular_paths(output / "cache", output)
    walk_regular_paths(output / "tmp", output)
    return indexed


def embedded_artifact(
    value: object, indexed: dict[str, dict[str, object]], role: str
) -> Path:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != ARTIFACT_FIELDS:
        raise ContractError("embedded artifact schema")
    relative = value.get("relativePath")
    if not isinstance(relative, str) or indexed.get(relative) != value:
        raise ContractError("embedded artifact binding")
    if value.get("role") != role:
        raise ContractError("embedded artifact role")
    return Path(relative)


def validate_command_rows(
    output: Path, commands: list[dict[str, object]],
    indexed: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
) -> None:
    if len(commands) != EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT:
        raise ContractError("command ledger count")
    expected_stages = (
        ["compiler-version"] + ["show-bin-path"] * 2
        + ["frontend-dryrun"] * 6 + ["primary"] * 86
    )
    referenced: set[str] = set()
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(commands):
        if (
            set(row) != COMMAND_FIELDS or row.get("schema") != COMMAND_SCHEMA
            or type(row.get("ordinal")) is not int
            or row.get("ordinal") != ordinal
            or row.get("stage") != expected_stages[ordinal]
            or not isinstance(row.get("argv"), list)
            or row.get("argvNULSHA256") != argv_sha(row["argv"])
            or type(row.get("exitCode")) is not int
            or row.get("exitCode") != 0
        ):
            raise ContractError("command row identity/status")
        if ordinal == 0:
            base = "provenance/commands/0000.compiler-version"
            if row["argv"] != ["/usr/bin/swiftc", "--version"]:
                raise ContractError("compiler command argv")
        elif ordinal in {1, 2}:
            config = CONFIGS[ordinal - 1]
            if (row["config"], row["target"], row["exactPath"]) != (config, "", ""):
                raise ContractError("show-bin-path command metadata")
            if row["argv"] != [
                "/usr/bin/swift", "build", "-c", config, "--show-bin-path",
            ]:
                raise ContractError("show-bin-path command argv")
            base = f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}.{config}.show-bin-path"
        elif 3 <= ordinal < 9:
            config, target = [
                (config, target)
                for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
            ][ordinal - 3]
            if (row["config"], row["target"], row["exactPath"]) != (config, target, ""):
                raise ContractError("dry-run command metadata")
            base = (
                f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}."
                f"{config}.{target}.dryrun"
            )
        else:
            config = row.get("config")
            target = row.get("target")
            exact_path = row.get("exactPath")
            if (
                config not in CONFIGS or target not in TARGETS
                or not isinstance(exact_path, str)
                or not exact_path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")
            ):
                raise ContractError("primary command metadata")
            base = f"corpus/{config}/{target}/{job_id(config, target, exact_path)}"
        if ordinal == 0 and (row["config"], row["target"], row["exactPath"]) != ("", "", ""):
            raise ContractError("compiler command metadata")
        expected_relatives = {
            "stdout": base + (
                ".ast.json" if row["stage"] == "primary" else ".stdout"
            ),
            "stderr": base + ".stderr", "exit": base + ".exit",
        }
        paths: dict[str, Path] = {}
        for key, role in (
            ("stdout", "process-stdout"), ("stderr", "process-stderr"),
            ("exit", "process-exit"),
        ):
            relative = embedded_artifact(row[key], indexed, role)
            text = relative.as_posix()
            if text != expected_relatives[key] or text in referenced:
                raise ContractError("duplicate process artifact ownership")
            referenced.add(text)
            paths[key] = output / relative
        expected_stderr = (
            EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDERR if row["stage"] == "compiler-version" else b""
        )
        require_process_evidence(paths["exit"], paths["stderr"], expected_stderr)
        if (
            row["stage"] == "compiler-version"
            and snapshot_bytes(paths["stdout"]) != EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDOUT
        ):
            raise ContractError("compiler stdout evidence")
    expected_process = {
        relative for relative, row in indexed.items()
        if str(row["role"]).startswith("process-")
    }
    require_exact_set(
        referenced, expected_process, "process artifact ownership closure"
    )


def require_top_level(output: Path, expected: set[str]) -> None:
    actual = {item.name for item in os.scandir(output)}
    require_exact_set(actual, expected, "terminal output top-level closure")


_VALIDATED_TERMINAL_SEAL = object()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ValidatedTerminalState:
    payload: bytes
    seal: object


def _validated_terminal_state(
    handoff: dict[str, object],
) -> ValidatedTerminalState:
    return ValidatedTerminalState(
        canonical_json(handoff) + b"\n", _VALIDATED_TERMINAL_SEAL,
    )


def publish_terminal_handoff(output: Path, state: ValidatedTerminalState) -> None:
    expected_fields = {
        "schema", "status", "repositoryRoot", "outputRoot", "corpusRoot",
        "manifest", "inventorySHA256", "producerSHA256", "scannerSHA256",
        "finalPathDigest", "compileInputVector", "compileInputVectorDigest",
        "artifactManifestSHA256", "ledgerSHA256", "progressSHA256",
        "counts", "allSuccess",
    }
    if (
        not isinstance(state, ValidatedTerminalState)
        or state.seal is not _VALIDATED_TERMINAL_SEAL
        or not state.payload.endswith(b"\n")
    ):
        raise ContractError("PASS writer requires complete ValidatedTerminalState")
    handoff = strict_json(state.payload[:-1], dictionary=True)
    assert isinstance(handoff, dict)
    if (
        state.payload != canonical_json(handoff) + b"\n"
        or set(handoff) != expected_fields
        or handoff.get("schema") != HANDOFF_SCHEMA
        or handoff.get("status") != "PASS"
        or handoff.get("allSuccess") is not True
    ):
        raise ContractError("PASS writer requires complete ValidatedTerminalState")
    counts = handoff.get("counts")
    expected_counts = {
        "configTargetRecords": 6,
        "dryrunPrimaries": EXPECTED_DRYRUN_PRIMARY_COUNT,
        "compileInputs": EXPECTED_COMPILE_INPUT_COUNT,
        "selectedJobs": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
        "commands": EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT,
        "progress": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
        "artifacts": EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT,
    }
    if (
        not isinstance(counts, dict)
        or set(counts) != set(expected_counts)
        or any(type(counts[key]) is not int for key in expected_counts)
        or counts != expected_counts
    ):
        raise ContractError("PASS writer count type closure")
    compile_inputs = handoff.get("compileInputVector")
    if (
        not isinstance(compile_inputs, list)
        or handoff.get("compileInputVectorDigest")
        != compile_input_vector_digest(compile_inputs)
    ):
        raise ContractError("PASS writer compile input vector closure")
    write_atomic_exclusive(output / "corpus-handoff.json", state.payload)


class CorpusWriter:
    def __init__(
        self, repo: Path, inventory: Path, output: Path,
        producer_path: Path, producer_sha: str, scanner_sha: str,
        final_paths: list[str],
    ) -> None:
        self.repo = repo
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.output = output
        self.inventory_sha = file_sha(inventory)
        self.producer_path = producer_path
        self.producer_sha = producer_sha
        self.scanner_sha = scanner_sha
        self.final_paths = final_paths
        self.ledger = output / "corpus-command-ledger.jsonl"
        self.progress_path = output / "corpus-progress.tsv"
        self.artifacts: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self.commands: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self.progress: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        self.configs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self.jobs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self.authority_lease: AuthorityDirectoryLease | None = None

    def prepare(self) -> None:
        for relative in (
            "corpus", "provenance", "provenance/commands",
            "provenance/descriptions", "provenance/records",
            "provenance/dryruns", "cache", "tmp",
        ):
            path = self.output / relative
            path.mkdir()
            require_directory(path)
        for relative in ("environment-swift", "environment-clang"):
            path = self.output / "cache" / relative
            path.mkdir()
            require_directory(path)
        for config in CONFIGS:
            for target in TARGETS:
                for kind in ("swift", "clang"):
                    path = self.output / "cache" / config / target / kind
                    path.mkdir(parents=True)
                    require_directory(path)

    def artifact(self, role: str, relative: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        safe_relative(relative)
        path = self.output / relative
        require_regular(path)
        if path.resolve(strict=True) != path or not contained(self.output, path):
            raise ContractError("artifact containment drift")
        if any(row["relativePath"] == relative for row in self.artifacts):
            raise ContractError("duplicate artifact path")
        row = {
            "ordinal": len(self.artifacts),
            "artifactID": sha(
                b"P1BTerminalASTArtifactV2\0" + role.encode() + b"\0"
                + relative.encode()
            ),
            "role": role,
            "relativePath": relative,
            "fileType": "regular",
            "bytes": len(snapshot_bytes(path)),
            "sha256": file_sha(path),
        }
        self.artifacts.append(row)
        return row

    def snapshot(self, role: str, relative: str, data: bytes) -> dict[str, object]:
        safe_relative(relative)
        path = self.output / relative
        require_directory(path.parent)
        with path.open("xb") as handle:
            handle.write(data)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        return self.artifact(role, relative)

    def run(
        self, stage: str, argv: list[str], slug: str, *,
        config: str = "", target: str = "", exact_path: str = "",
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bytes]:
        CONTEXT.stage = stage
        CONTEXT.config = config
        CONTEXT.target = target
        CONTEXT.exact_path = exact_path
        if len(self.commands) >= EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT:
            raise ContractError("command ledger overflow")
        base = f"provenance/commands/{len(self.commands):04d}.{slug}"
        if stage == "primary":
            identifier = job_id(config, target, exact_path)
            base = f"corpus/{config}/{target}/{identifier}"
            (self.output / f"corpus/{config}/{target}").mkdir(
                parents=True, exist_ok=True
            )
        stdout_relative = base + (".ast.json" if stage == "primary" else ".stdout")
        stderr_relative = base + ".stderr"
        exit_relative = base + ".exit"
        stdout_path = self.output / stdout_relative
        stderr_path = self.output / stderr_relative
        exit_path = self.output / exit_relative
        require_directory(stdout_path.parent)
        with stdout_path.open("xb") as stdout, stderr_path.open("xb") as stderr:
            runtime_lease = hold_runtime_directories(self.repo, self.output)
            try:
                completed = subprocess.run(
                    argv, cwd=self.repo,
                    env=deterministic_environment(self.output),
                    stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False,
                )
                runtime_lease.verify(self.output)
            finally:
                runtime_lease.close()
        with exit_path.open("xb") as handle:
            handle.write(f"{completed.returncode}\n".encode("ascii"))
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        stdout_row = self.artifact("process-stdout", stdout_relative)
        stderr_row = self.artifact("process-stderr", stderr_relative)
        exit_row = self.artifact("process-exit", exit_relative)
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema": COMMAND_SCHEMA,
            "ordinal": len(self.commands),
            "stage": stage,
            "config": config,
            "target": target,
            "exactPath": exact_path,
            "argv": argv,
            "argvNULSHA256": argv_sha(argv),
            "exitCode": completed.returncode,
            "stdout": stdout_row,
            "stderr": stderr_row,
            "exit": exit_row,
        }
        with self.ledger.open("ab") as handle:
            handle.write(canonical_json(row) + b"\n")
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        self.commands.append(row)
        return row, snapshot_bytes(stdout_path)

    def append_progress(self, row: dict[str, str]) -> None:
        self.progress.append(row)
        buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            buffer, fieldnames=PROGRESS_FIELDS, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n"
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(self.progress)
        write_atomic(self.progress_path, buffer.getvalue().encode())

    def _artifact_manifest_payload(self) -> bytes:
        fields = (
            "ordinal", "artifactID", "role", "relativePath", "fileType",
            "bytes", "sha256",
        )
        buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            buffer, fieldnames=fields, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n"
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(self.artifacts)
        return buffer.getvalue().encode()

    def _progress_payload(self) -> bytes:
        buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            buffer, fieldnames=PROGRESS_FIELDS, delimiter="\t",
            lineterminator="\n",
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(self.progress)
        return buffer.getvalue().encode()

    def _validate_terminal_rows(
        self, indexed: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
        descriptions: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
        source_rows: list[dict[str, object]],
    ) -> None:
        expected_pairs = [
            (config, target) for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
        ]
        if (
            len(self.configs) != 6
            or [
                (row.get("config"), row.get("target")) for row in self.configs
            ] != expected_pairs
        ):
            raise ContractError("config-target topology")
        nonprocess_references: set[str] = set()
        if set(descriptions) != set(CONFIGS):
            raise ContractError("description topology")
        for config in CONFIGS:
            values = descriptions[config]
            if set(values) != {"livePath", "liveSHA256", "artifact"}:
                raise ContractError("description binding schema")
            relative = embedded_artifact(
                values["artifact"], indexed, "swiftpm-description"
            ).as_posix()
            if (
                relative != f"provenance/descriptions/{config}.description.json"
                or relative in nonprocess_references
            ):
                raise ContractError("duplicate nonprocess artifact owner")
            artifact_row = indexed[relative]
            if artifact_row["sha256"] != values["liveSHA256"]:
                raise ContractError("description snapshot/live hash drift")
            nonprocess_references.add(relative)
        config_by_pair: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, object]] = {}
        for pair_index, row in enumerate(self.configs):
            if set(row) != CONFIG_FIELDS:
                raise ContractError("config row fields")
            pair = (str(row["config"]), str(row["target"]))
            config_by_pair[pair] = row
            for key, role, expected_relative in (
                (
                    "recordArtifact", "swift-command-record",
                    f"provenance/records/{pair[0]}.{pair[1]}.record.json",
                ),
                (
                    "dryrunArtifact", "frontend-dryrun-jobs",
                    f"provenance/dryruns/{pair[0]}.{pair[1]}.jobs.json",
                ),
            ):
                relative = embedded_artifact(row[key], indexed, role).as_posix()
                if relative != expected_relative or relative in nonprocess_references:
                    raise ContractError("duplicate nonprocess artifact owner")
                nonprocess_references.add(relative)
            if (
                row["selectedCount"] != EXPECTED_SELECTED_COUNTS[pair[1]]
                or row["baseArgvNULSHA256"] != argv_sha(row["baseArgv"])
                or row["baseSemanticSignature"]
                != semantic_signature(row["baseArgv"], row["sourceOrder"])
            ):
                raise ContractError("config row semantic drift")
            record_relative = (
                f"provenance/records/{pair[0]}.{pair[1]}.record.json"
            )
            record_payload = strict_json(
                snapshot_bytes(self.output / record_relative), dictionary=True,
            )
            if (
                not isinstance(record_payload, dict)
                or set(record_payload) != {"recordKey", "record"}
                or record_payload["recordKey"] != row["recordKey"]
                or not isinstance(record_payload["record"], dict)
                or sha(canonical_json(record_payload["record"]))
                != row["recordSHA256"]
            ):
                raise ContractError("record artifact semantic drift")
            base, removed, rewritten = transform_record(
                record_payload["record"], self.output, pair[0], pair[1]
            )
            if (
                base != row["baseArgv"] or removed != row["removed"]
                or rewritten != row["rewritten"]
                or record_payload["record"].get("sources") != row["sourceOrder"]
            ):
                raise ContractError("record/config transform drift")
            dryrun_relative = (
                f"provenance/dryruns/{pair[0]}.{pair[1]}.jobs.json"
            )
            dryrun_payload = strict_json(
                snapshot_bytes(self.output / dryrun_relative), dictionary=True,
            )
            if (
                not isinstance(dryrun_payload, dict)
                or set(dryrun_payload) != {
                    "schema", "config", "target", "jobs", "argvNULSHA256",
                }
                or dryrun_payload["schema"] != DRYRUN_SCHEMA
                or (dryrun_payload["config"], dryrun_payload["target"]) != pair
                or not isinstance(dryrun_payload["jobs"], list)
            ):
                raise ContractError("dry-run artifact schema")
            jobs = dryrun_payload["jobs"]
            hashes = [argv_sha(argv) for argv in jobs]
            command = self.commands[3 + pair_index]
            command_stdout = self.output / embedded_artifact(
                command["stdout"], indexed, "process-stdout"
            )
            reparsed = parse_dryrun(
                snapshot_bytes(command_stdout), row["sourceOrder"], self.output,
                pair[0], pair[1],
            )
            if (
                jobs != reparsed or dryrun_payload["argvNULSHA256"] != hashes
                or row["dryrunPrimaryCount"] != len(jobs)
                or row["dryrunArgvNULSHA256"] != hashes
                or command["argv"] != base + ["-###"]
            ):
                raise ContractError("dry-run/config replay drift")
        expected_nonprocess = {
            relative for relative, row in indexed.items()
            if not str(row["role"]).startswith("process-")
        }
        require_exact_set(
            nonprocess_references, expected_nonprocess,
            "nonprocess artifact ownership closure",
        )
        source_by_path = {str(row["exactPath"]): row for row in source_rows}
        if list(source_by_path) != self.final_paths:
            raise ContractError("source vector order")
        if len(self.jobs) != EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT:
            raise ContractError("job count")
        selected_counts = {
            (config, target): 0 for config, target in expected_pairs
        }
        for ordinal, job in enumerate(self.jobs):
            if (
                set(job) != JOB_FIELDS or type(job.get("ordinal")) is not int
                or job.get("ordinal") != ordinal
            ):
                raise ContractError("job row schema/order")
            config = str(job["config"])
            target = str(job["target"])
            exact_path = str(job["exactPath"])
            pair = (config, target)
            if pair not in config_by_pair or exact_path not in source_by_path:
                raise ContractError("job config/source closure")
            if not exact_path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/"):
                raise ContractError("job target/source mismatch")
            command_ordinal = 9 + ordinal
            command = self.commands[command_ordinal]
            if (
                job["commandOrdinal"] != command_ordinal
                or command["stage"] != "primary"
                or (command["config"], command["target"], command["exactPath"])
                != (config, target, exact_path)
                or command["argv"] != job["argv"]
                or job["stdout"] != command["stdout"]
                or job["stderr"] != command["stderr"]
                or job["exit"] != command["exit"]
                or job["jobID"] != job_id(config, target, exact_path)
                or job["argvNULSHA256"] != argv_sha(job["argv"])
            ):
                raise ContractError("job/command identity drift")
            sources = config_by_pair[pair]["sourceOrder"]
            validate_frontend(job["argv"], sources, self.output, config, target)
            if (
                job["semanticSignature"] != semantic_signature(job["argv"], sources)
                or job["primarySource"]
                != singleton_value(job["argv"], "-primary-file")
            ):
                raise ContractError("job semantic signature drift")
            source = source_by_path[exact_path]
            if (
                job["sourceBytes"] != source["bytes"]
                or job["sourceSHA256"] != source["sha256"]
            ):
                raise ContractError("job source binding")
            stdout = self.output / embedded_artifact(
                job["stdout"], indexed, "process-stdout"
            )
            stderr = self.output / embedded_artifact(
                job["stderr"], indexed, "process-stderr"
            )
            exit_path = self.output / embedded_artifact(
                job["exit"], indexed, "process-exit"
            )
            require_process_evidence(exit_path, stderr)
            stdout_raw = snapshot_bytes(stdout)
            if not stdout_raw:
                raise ContractError("empty primary AST")
            parse_json_dictionary_isolated(stdout, str(self.repo / exact_path))
            expected_progress = {
                "ordinal": str(ordinal), "jobID": str(job["jobID"]),
                "config": config, "target": target, "exactPath": exact_path,
                "sourceBytes": str(source["bytes"]),
                "sourceSHA256": str(source["sha256"]),
                "commandSHA256": str(job["argvNULSHA256"]), "exit": "0",
                "stdoutBytes": str(len(stdout_raw)),
                "stdoutSHA256": file_sha(stdout), "stderrBytes": "0",
                "stderrSHA256": sha(b""), "validJSON": "yes",
                "jsonKind": "dict",
            }
            if self.progress[ordinal] != expected_progress:
                raise ContractError("progress/job drift")
            selected_counts[pair] += 1
        expected_selected = {
            (config, target): EXPECTED_SELECTED_COUNTS[target]
            for config, target in expected_pairs
        }
        if selected_counts != expected_selected:
            raise ContractError("selected job pair arithmetic")

    def finalize(
        self, entry_paths: list[str], descriptions: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
        source_rows: list[dict[str, object]],
        compile_inputs: list[dict[str, object]],
    ) -> None:
        if len(self.commands) != EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT:
            raise ContractError("command ledger count")
        if len(self.progress) != EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT:
            raise ContractError("progress count")
        if len(self.artifacts) != EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT:
            raise ContractError("artifact count")
        compile_input_digest = recheck_compile_input_vector(
            self.configs, compile_inputs
        )
        artifact_manifest = self.output / "corpus-artifact-manifest.tsv"
        write_atomic(artifact_manifest, self._artifact_manifest_payload())
        counts = {
            "configTargetRecords": len(self.configs),
            "dryrunPrimaries": sum(int(row["dryrunPrimaryCount"]) for row in self.configs),
            "compileInputs": len(compile_inputs),
            "selectedJobs": len(self.jobs),
            "commands": len(self.commands),
            "progress": len(self.progress),
            "artifacts": len(self.artifacts),
        }
        expected_counts = {
            "configTargetRecords": 6,
            "dryrunPrimaries": EXPECTED_DRYRUN_PRIMARY_COUNT,
            "compileInputs": EXPECTED_COMPILE_INPUT_COUNT,
            "selectedJobs": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
            "commands": EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT,
            "progress": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
            "artifacts": EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT,
        }
        all_success = (
            all(row["exitCode"] == 0 for row in self.commands)
            and all(row["validJSON"] == "yes" for row in self.progress)
        )
        if counts != expected_counts or not all_success:
            raise ContractError("terminal success arithmetic")
        manifest = {
            "schema": CORPUS_SCHEMA,
            "status": "PASS",
            "repositoryRoot": str(self.repo),
            "outputRoot": str(self.output),
            "corpusRoot": str(self.output / "corpus"),
            "inventory": {"path": str(self.inventory), "sha256": self.inventory_sha},
            "producer": {"sha256": self.producer_sha},
            "scanner": {"sha256": self.scanner_sha},
            "compiler": {
                "stdout": EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDOUT.decode(),
                "stderr": EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDERR.decode(),
            },
            "entryPaths": entry_paths,
            "entryPathDigest": path_vector_digest(entry_paths),
            "finalPaths": self.final_paths,
            "finalPathDigest": path_vector_digest(self.final_paths),
            "sourceVector": source_rows,
            "sourceVectorDigest": source_vector_digest(source_rows),
            "compileInputVector": compile_inputs,
            "compileInputVectorDigest": compile_input_digest,
            "descriptions": descriptions,
            "configs": self.configs,
            "jobs": self.jobs,
            "counts": counts,
            "ledger": self._file_binding("corpus-command-ledger.jsonl"),
            "progress": self._file_binding("corpus-progress.tsv"),
            "artifactManifest": self._file_binding("corpus-artifact-manifest.tsv"),
            "allSuccess": True,
        }
        manifest_path = self.output / "corpus-manifest.json"
        write_atomic(manifest_path, canonical_json(manifest) + b"\n")

        # This is the single retained-byte terminal validation pass.  Every
        # indexed file is descriptor-anchored once; hashing and all 86 AST
        # parses consume that same immutable byte snapshot.
        require_top_level(self.output, {
            "corpus", "provenance", "cache", "tmp",
            "corpus-command-ledger.jsonl", "corpus-progress.tsv",
            "corpus-artifact-manifest.tsv", "corpus-manifest.json",
        })
        if (
            snapshot_bytes(self.ledger)
            != b"".join(canonical_json(row) + b"\n" for row in self.commands)
            or snapshot_bytes(self.progress_path) != self._progress_payload()
            or snapshot_bytes(artifact_manifest) != self._artifact_manifest_payload()
            or snapshot_bytes(manifest_path) != canonical_json(manifest) + b"\n"
        ):
            raise ContractError("terminal authority serialization drift")
        indexed = validate_artifact_rows(self.output, self.artifacts)
        validate_command_rows(self.output, self.commands, indexed)
        self._validate_terminal_rows(indexed, descriptions, source_rows)
        if file_sha(self.inventory) != self.inventory_sha:
            raise ContractError("inventory changed during production")
        if file_sha(self.producer_path) != self.producer_sha:
            raise ContractError("producer changed during production")
        for values in descriptions.values():
            live = Path(str(values["livePath"]))
            require_regular(live)
            if (
                live.resolve(strict=True) != live
                or not snapshot_bytes(live)
                or file_sha(live) != values["liveSHA256"]
            ):
                raise ContractError("description changed during production")
        for row in source_rows:
            path = self.repo / str(row["exactPath"])
            require_regular(path)
            if (
                path.resolve(strict=True) != path
                or len(snapshot_bytes(path)) != row["bytes"]
                or file_sha(path) != row["sha256"]
            ):
                raise ContractError("source changed during production")
        # Replay every validator against retained bytes.  A pathname identity
        # check immediately before publication detects replacement without a
        # second content read.
        validate_artifact_rows(self.output, self.artifacts)
        if (
            snapshot_bytes(self.ledger)
            != b"".join(canonical_json(row) + b"\n" for row in self.commands)
            or snapshot_bytes(self.progress_path) != self._progress_payload()
            or snapshot_bytes(artifact_manifest) != self._artifact_manifest_payload()
            or snapshot_bytes(manifest_path) != canonical_json(manifest) + b"\n"
        ):
            raise ContractError("terminal authority changed after recheck")
        terminal_compile_input_digest = recheck_compile_input_vector(
            self.configs, compile_inputs
        )
        if terminal_compile_input_digest != compile_input_digest:
            raise ContractError("compile input vector changed after AST validation")
        handoff = {
            "schema": HANDOFF_SCHEMA,
            "status": "PASS",
            "repositoryRoot": str(self.repo),
            "outputRoot": str(self.output),
            "corpusRoot": str(self.output / "corpus"),
            "manifest": self._file_binding("corpus-manifest.json"),
            "inventorySHA256": self.inventory_sha,
            "producerSHA256": self.producer_sha,
            "scannerSHA256": self.scanner_sha,
            "finalPathDigest": path_vector_digest(self.final_paths),
            "compileInputVector": compile_inputs,
            "compileInputVectorDigest": compile_input_digest,
            "artifactManifestSHA256": file_sha(artifact_manifest),
            "ledgerSHA256": file_sha(self.ledger),
            "progressSHA256": file_sha(self.progress_path),
            "counts": counts,
            "allSuccess": True,
        }
        validate_runtime_directories(self.output)
        recheck_all_snapshot_identities()
        if (
            self.authority_lease is None
            or set(self.authority_lease.descriptors)
            != {self.repo, self.output, self.output / "corpus"}
        ):
            raise ContractError("producer authority directory lease closure")
        self.authority_lease.verify()
        # Exclusive publication is the last filesystem operation in successful
        # production.  No fallible check follows a PASS handoff.
        publish_terminal_handoff(
            self.output, _validated_terminal_state(handoff)
        )

    def _file_binding(self, relative: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        path = self.output / relative
        require_regular(path)
        return {
            "path": relative, "bytes": len(snapshot_bytes(path)),
            "sha256": file_sha(path),
        }


def validate_inputs(
    root: Path, inventory: Path, output_root: Path
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path]:
    repo = exact_root(root)
    output = exact_root(output_root)
    if repo == output or contained(repo, output) or contained(output, repo):
        raise ContractError("repository/output overlap")
    if any(os.scandir(output)):
        raise ContractError("output root is not empty")
    if not inventory.is_absolute():
        raise ContractError("inventory is relative")
    require_regular(inventory)
    if inventory.resolve(strict=True) != inventory or not contained(repo, inventory):
        raise ContractError("inventory is not a canonical repository file")
    package = repo / "Package.swift"
    require_regular(package)
    return repo, inventory, output


def exact_executable(name: str, expected: str) -> str:
    resolved = shutil.which(name)
    if resolved is None or str(Path(resolved).resolve(strict=True)) != expected:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} executable drift")
    return expected


def validate_bin_path(repo: Path, config: str, stdout: bytes) -> Path:
    try:
        lines = stdout.decode().splitlines()
    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path encoding") from error
    if len(lines) != 1 or not lines[0]:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path cardinality")
    path = Path(lines[0])
    require_directory(path)
    if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path realpath drift")
    try:
        pieces = path.relative_to(repo / ".build").parts
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path outside workspace build root") from error
    if len(pieces) != 2 or pieces[1] != config or not pieces[0]:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path canonical shape")
    return path


def selected_paths(final_paths: list[str], target: str) -> list[str]:
    rows = [
        path for path in final_paths if path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")
    ]
    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_SELECTED_COUNTS[target]:
        raise ContractError("selected path target count")
    return rows


def source_rows(repo: Path, final_paths: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for exact_path in final_paths:
        path = repo / exact_path
        require_regular(path)
        if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
            raise ContractError("selected source realpath drift")
        rows.append({
            "exactPath": exact_path,
            "bytes": len(snapshot_bytes(path)),
            "sha256": file_sha(path),
        })
    return rows


def _expect(name: str, operation: object, results: list[str]) -> None:
    try:
        operation()  # type: ignore[operator]
    except (ContractError, FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        results.append(name)
        return
    raise AssertionError(f"negative probe did not fail: {name}")


def _reject(condition: bool) -> None:
    if condition:
        raise ContractError("expected probe rejection")


def _compile_input_probe_fixture(
    base: Path,
) -> tuple[
    list[dict[str, object]], list[dict[str, object]], Path, Path,
]:
    source_root = base / "sources"
    derived_root = base / "derived"
    source_root.mkdir(parents=True)
    derived_root.mkdir()
    by_target: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for target in TARGETS:
        directory = source_root / target
        directory.mkdir()
        regular_count = EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNTS[target]
        if target == "AgentLoopApp":
            regular_count -= 1
        values: list[str] = []
        for index in range(regular_count):
            path = directory / f"Source{index:03d}.swift"
            path.write_bytes(f"{target}:{index}\n".encode())
            values.append(str(path.resolve(strict=True)))
        by_target[target] = values
    derived = derived_root / "resource_bundle_accessor.swift"
    derived.write_bytes(b"derived\n")
    by_target["AgentLoopApp"].append(str(derived.resolve(strict=True)))
    configs = [
        {
            "config": config,
            "target": target,
            "sourceOrder": list(by_target[target]),
        }
        for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
    ]
    vector = compile_input_vector(configs)
    if len(vector) != EXPECTED_COMPILE_INPUT_COUNT:
        raise AssertionError("compile input probe fixture count")
    sibling = Path(by_target["AgentLoopCore"][1])
    return configs, vector, sibling, derived.resolve(strict=True)


def _finalize_probe_writer(
    base: Path, failure: str,
) -> tuple[CorpusWriter, list[dict[str, object]]]:
    repo = base / "repo"
    output = base / "output"
    repo.mkdir(parents=True)
    output.mkdir()
    inventory = repo / "inventory.md"
    inventory.write_text("probe inventory\n")
    producer = base / "producer.py"
    producer.write_text("# probe producer\n")
    writer = CorpusWriter(
        repo, inventory, output, producer, file_sha(producer), "0" * 64,
        ["Sources/AgentLoopCore/Probe.swift"],
    )
    writer.prepare()
    _activate_snapshots(repo, output, Path(__file__).resolve(strict=True).parent)

    pairs = [
        (config, target) for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
    ]
    for ordinal in range(EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT):
        if ordinal == 0:
            stage, config, target, exact_path = "compiler-version", "", "", ""
            argv = ["/usr/bin/swiftc", "--version"]
            base_relative = "provenance/commands/0000.compiler-version"
        elif ordinal in {1, 2}:
            stage, config, target, exact_path = (
                "show-bin-path", CONFIGS[ordinal - 1], "", ""
            )
            argv = [
                "/usr/bin/swift", "build", "-c", config, "--show-bin-path",
            ]
            base_relative = (
                f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}.{config}.show-bin-path"
            )
        elif 3 <= ordinal < 9:
            stage, (config, target), exact_path = (
                "frontend-dryrun", pairs[ordinal - 3], ""
            )
            argv = ["/probe/swiftc", "-###"]
            base_relative = (
                f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}."
                f"{config}.{target}.dryrun"
            )
        else:
            stage, config, target = "primary", "debug", "AgentLoopCore"
            exact_path = f"Sources/AgentLoopCore/Probe{ordinal - 9:03d}.swift"
            argv = ["/probe/swift-frontend", exact_path]
            base_relative = (
                f"corpus/{config}/{target}/"
                f"{job_id(config, target, exact_path)}"
            )
        stdout_relative = base_relative + (
            ".ast.json" if stage == "primary" else ".stdout"
        )
        stderr_relative = base_relative + ".stderr"
        exit_relative = base_relative + ".exit"
        stdout_data = EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDOUT if ordinal == 0 else b"x"
        stderr_data = EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDERR if ordinal == 0 else b""
        if failure == "stderr" and ordinal == 3:
            stderr_data = b"probe failure"
        exit_code = 1 if failure == "exit" and ordinal == 3 else 0
        for relative, data in (
            (stdout_relative, stdout_data), (stderr_relative, stderr_data),
            (exit_relative, f"{exit_code}\n".encode()),
        ):
            path = output / relative
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(data)
        stdout = writer.artifact("process-stdout", stdout_relative)
        stderr = writer.artifact("process-stderr", stderr_relative)
        exit_row = writer.artifact("process-exit", exit_relative)
        writer.commands.append({
            "schema": COMMAND_SCHEMA, "ordinal": ordinal, "stage": stage,
            "config": config, "target": target, "exactPath": exact_path,
            "argv": argv, "argvNULSHA256": argv_sha(argv),
            "exitCode": exit_code, "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr,
            "exit": exit_row,
        })
    for config in CONFIGS:
        relative = f"provenance/descriptions/{config}.description.json"
        (output / relative).write_bytes(b"{}")
        writer.artifact("swiftpm-description", relative)
    for config, target in pairs:
        for role, relative in (
            (
                "swift-command-record",
                f"provenance/records/{config}.{target}.record.json",
            ),
            (
                "frontend-dryrun-jobs",
                f"provenance/dryruns/{config}.{target}.jobs.json",
            ),
        ):
            (output / relative).write_bytes(b"{}")
            writer.artifact(role, relative)
    if len(writer.artifacts) != EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT:
        raise AssertionError("finalize probe artifact arithmetic")
    probe_configs, compile_inputs, _, _ = _compile_input_probe_fixture(
        base / "compile-input-fixture"
    )
    writer.configs = [
        {**row, "dryrunPrimaryCount": 44, "probe": index}
        for index, row in enumerate(probe_configs)
    ]
    writer.jobs = [{"probe": index} for index in range(86)]
    writer.progress = [{
        "ordinal": str(index), "jobID": f"probe-{index}",
        "config": "debug", "target": "AgentLoopCore",
        "exactPath": f"Sources/AgentLoopCore/Probe{index:03d}.swift",
        "sourceBytes": "1", "sourceSHA256": sha(b"x"),
        "commandSHA256": sha(b"probe"), "exit": "0",
        "stdoutBytes": "1", "stdoutSHA256": sha(b"x"),
        "stderrBytes": "0", "stderrSHA256": sha(b""),
        "validJSON": "yes", "jsonKind": "dict",
    } for index in range(86)]
    writer.ledger.write_bytes(b"".join(
        canonical_json(row) + b"\n" for row in writer.commands
    ))
    writer.progress_path.write_bytes(writer._progress_payload())
    if failure == "closure":
        (output / "provenance" / "unindexed-extra").write_bytes(b"extra")
    return writer, compile_inputs


def _probe_finalize_rejection(
    base: Path, failure: str, entry_paths: list[str]
) -> None:
    writer, compile_inputs = _finalize_probe_writer(base, failure)
    try:
        writer.finalize(entry_paths, {}, [], compile_inputs)
    except ContractError:
        if (writer.output / "corpus-handoff.json").exists():
            raise AssertionError("rejected finalize published PASS")
        raise ContractError("expected finalize rejection observed")
    finally:
        _deactivate_snapshots()
    raise AssertionError("negative finalize probe unexpectedly passed")


def _publication_probe_handoff(output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    compile_inputs = [
        {
            "ordinal": ordinal, "config": config, "target": target,
            "sourceOperand": f"/probe/{config}/{target}/{index:03d}.swift",
            "bytes": 1, "sha256": sha(b"x"),
        }
        for ordinal, (config, target, index) in enumerate(
            (config, target, index)
            for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
            for index in range(EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNTS[target])
        )
    ]
    return {
        "schema": HANDOFF_SCHEMA, "status": "PASS",
        "repositoryRoot": "/probe/repo", "outputRoot": str(output),
        "corpusRoot": str(output / "corpus"),
        "manifest": {"path": "corpus-manifest.json", "bytes": 1,
                     "sha256": "0" * 64},
        "inventorySHA256": "1" * 64, "producerSHA256": "2" * 64,
        "scannerSHA256": "3" * 64,
        "finalPathDigest": EXPECTED_FINAL_PATH_DIGEST,
        "compileInputVector": compile_inputs,
        "compileInputVectorDigest": compile_input_vector_digest(compile_inputs),
        "artifactManifestSHA256": "5" * 64,
        "ledgerSHA256": "6" * 64, "progressSHA256": "7" * 64,
        "counts": {
            "configTargetRecords": 6,
            "dryrunPrimaries": EXPECTED_DRYRUN_PRIMARY_COUNT,
            "compileInputs": EXPECTED_COMPILE_INPUT_COUNT,
            "selectedJobs": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
            "commands": EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT,
            "progress": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
            "artifacts": EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT,
        },
        "allSuccess": True,
    }


def _probe_successful_pass_publication(output: Path) -> None:
    output.mkdir()
    handoff = _publication_probe_handoff(output)
    state = _validated_terminal_state(handoff)
    handoff["status"] = "MUTATED"
    publish_terminal_handoff(output, state)
    if snapshot_bytes(output / "corpus-handoff.json") != state.payload:
        raise AssertionError("successful PASS publication payload drift")


def _probe_successful_finalize(base: Path) -> None:
    """Exercise the real CorpusWriter.finalize success path at 299/95/86/264."""
    base = base.resolve()
    repo = base / "repo"; output = base / "output"
    repo.mkdir(parents=True); output.mkdir()
    inventory = repo / "inventory.md"; inventory.write_text("probe inventory\n")
    producer = base / "producer.py"; producer.write_text("# probe producer\n")
    final_paths: list[str] = []
    source_orders: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for target in TARGETS:
        selected_count = EXPECTED_SELECTED_COUNTS[target]
        total_count = EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNTS[target]
        selected_relatives = [
            f"Sources/{target}/Selected{index:03d}.swift"
            for index in range(selected_count)
        ]
        other_relatives = [
            f"Sources/{target}/Other{index:03d}.swift"
            for index in range(total_count - selected_count)
        ]
        relatives = selected_relatives + other_relatives
        absolute: list[str] = []
        for relative in relatives:
            path = repo / relative
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            raw = ("// " + relative + "\n").encode()
            path.write_bytes(raw)
            absolute.append(str(path))
            if relative in selected_relatives:
                final_paths.append(relative)
                source_rows.append({
                    "exactPath": relative, "bytes": len(raw),
                    "sha256": sha(raw),
                })
        source_orders[target] = absolute
    if len(final_paths) != 43:
        raise AssertionError("successful finalize final path arithmetic")

    writer = CorpusWriter(
        repo, inventory, output, producer, file_sha(producer), "0" * 64,
        final_paths,
    )
    writer.prepare()

    def add_process(
        stage: str, argv: list[str], base_relative: str,
        stdout_raw: bytes, *, config: str = "", target: str = "",
        exact_path: str = "", stderr_raw: bytes = b"",
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        stdout_relative = base_relative + (
            ".ast.json" if stage == "primary" else ".stdout"
        )
        stderr_relative = base_relative + ".stderr"
        exit_relative = base_relative + ".exit"
        for relative, raw in (
            (stdout_relative, stdout_raw), (stderr_relative, stderr_raw),
            (exit_relative, b"0\n"),
        ):
            path = output / relative
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(raw)
        stdout = writer.artifact("process-stdout", stdout_relative)
        stderr = writer.artifact("process-stderr", stderr_relative)
        exit_row = writer.artifact("process-exit", exit_relative)
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema": COMMAND_SCHEMA, "ordinal": len(writer.commands),
            "stage": stage, "config": config, "target": target,
            "exactPath": exact_path, "argv": argv,
            "argvNULSHA256": argv_sha(argv), "exitCode": 0,
            "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr, "exit": exit_row,
        }
        writer.commands.append(row)
        return row

    add_process(
        "compiler-version", ["/usr/bin/swiftc", "--version"],
        "provenance/commands/0000.compiler-version",
        EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDOUT, stderr_raw=EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDERR,
    )
    for config in CONFIGS:
        ordinal = len(writer.commands)
        add_process(
            "show-bin-path",
            ["/usr/bin/swift", "build", "-c", config, "--show-bin-path"],
            f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}.{config}.show-bin-path",
            f"/probe/{config}\n".encode(), config=config,
        )

    pair_jobs: dict[tuple[str, str], list[list[str]]] = {}
    descriptions: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    description_raw = canonical_json({"probe": True}) + b"\n"
    for config in CONFIGS:
        live = base / "live" / f"{config}.description.json"
        live.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        live.write_bytes(description_raw)
        relative = f"provenance/descriptions/{config}.description.json"
        description_artifact = writer.snapshot(
            "swiftpm-description", relative, description_raw,
        )
        descriptions[config] = {
            "livePath": str(live), "liveSHA256": sha(description_raw),
            "artifact": description_artifact,
        }

    for config in CONFIGS:
        for target in TARGETS:
            sources = source_orders[target]
            arguments = [
                "-target", "arm64-probe", "-sdk", "/probe/sdk",
                "-module-cache-path", "/probe/old-swift-cache",
                "-Onone" if config == "debug" else "-O",
            ]
            if config == "debug":
                arguments += ["-D", "DEBUG"]
            arguments += ["-Xcc", "-fmodules-cache-path=/probe/old-clang-cache"]
            record: dict[str, object] = {
                "executable": "/probe/swiftc", "importPath": "/probe/import",
                "moduleName": target, "otherArguments": arguments,
                "sources": sources,
            }
            record_key = f"{config}.{target}"
            record_payload = canonical_json({
                "recordKey": record_key, "record": record,
            }) + b"\n"
            record_artifact = writer.snapshot(
                "swift-command-record",
                f"provenance/records/{config}.{target}.record.json",
                record_payload,
            )
            base_argv, removed, rewritten = transform_record(
                record, output, config, target,
            )
            frontend_jobs: list[list[str]] = []
            for primary in sources:
                argv = [
                    "/probe/swift-frontend", "-frontend", "-dump-ast",
                    "-dump-ast-format", "json", "-module-name", target,
                    "-target", "arm64-probe", "-sdk", "/probe/sdk",
                    "-module-cache-path",
                    str(output / "cache" / config / target / "swift"),
                    "-Onone" if config == "debug" else "-O",
                ]
                if config == "debug":
                    argv += ["-D", "DEBUG"]
                argv += [
                    "-Xcc", "-fmodules-cache-path="
                    + str(output / "cache" / config / target / "clang"),
                    "-o", "-",
                ]
                for source in sources:
                    argv.extend(
                        ["-primary-file", source]
                        if source == primary else [source]
                    )
                validate_frontend(argv, sources, output, config, target)
                frontend_jobs.append(argv)
            pair_jobs[(config, target)] = frontend_jobs
            dryrun_payload = canonical_json({
                "schema": DRYRUN_SCHEMA, "config": config, "target": target,
                "jobs": frontend_jobs,
                "argvNULSHA256": [argv_sha(argv) for argv in frontend_jobs],
            }) + b"\n"
            dryrun_artifact = writer.snapshot(
                "frontend-dryrun-jobs",
                f"provenance/dryruns/{config}.{target}.jobs.json",
                dryrun_payload,
            )
            stdout_raw = (
                "\n".join(shlex.join(argv) for argv in frontend_jobs) + "\n"
            ).encode()
            ordinal = len(writer.commands)
            add_process(
                "frontend-dryrun", base_argv + ["-###"],
                f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}.{config}.{target}.dryrun",
                stdout_raw, config=config, target=target,
            )
            writer.configs.append({
                "config": config, "target": target,
                "recordKey": record_key, "recordArtifact": record_artifact,
                "recordSHA256": sha(canonical_json(record)),
                "sourceOrder": sources, "baseArgv": base_argv,
                "baseArgvNULSHA256": argv_sha(base_argv),
                "baseSemanticSignature": semantic_signature(base_argv, sources),
                "removed": removed, "rewritten": rewritten,
                "dryrunArtifact": dryrun_artifact,
                "dryrunPrimaryCount": len(frontend_jobs),
                "dryrunArgvNULSHA256": [
                    argv_sha(argv) for argv in frontend_jobs
                ],
                "selectedCount": EXPECTED_SELECTED_COUNTS[target],
            })

    source_by_path = {
        str(row["exactPath"]): row for row in source_rows
    }
    for config in CONFIGS:
        for target in TARGETS:
            selected = set(
                path for path in final_paths
                if path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")
            )
            sources = source_orders[target]
            for argv in pair_jobs[(config, target)]:
                primary = singleton_value(argv, "-primary-file")
                exact_path = str(Path(primary).relative_to(repo))
                if exact_path not in selected:
                    continue
                identifier = job_id(config, target, exact_path)
                ast_raw = canonical_json({
                    "_kind": "source_file", "filename": str(repo / exact_path),
                    "compiler_version": AST_COMPILER_VERSION, "items": [],
                }) + b"\n"
                command_ordinal = len(writer.commands)
                command = add_process(
                    "primary", argv,
                    f"corpus/{config}/{target}/{identifier}", ast_raw,
                    config=config, target=target, exact_path=exact_path,
                )
                source = source_by_path[exact_path]
                job: dict[str, object] = {
                    "ordinal": len(writer.jobs), "jobID": identifier,
                    "config": config, "target": target,
                    "exactPath": exact_path, "primarySource": primary,
                    "sourceBytes": source["bytes"],
                    "sourceSHA256": source["sha256"], "argv": argv,
                    "argvNULSHA256": argv_sha(argv),
                    "semanticSignature": semantic_signature(argv, sources),
                    "commandOrdinal": command_ordinal,
                    "stdout": command["stdout"], "stderr": command["stderr"],
                    "exit": command["exit"],
                }
                writer.jobs.append(job)
                writer.progress.append({
                    "ordinal": str(job["ordinal"]), "jobID": identifier,
                    "config": config, "target": target,
                    "exactPath": exact_path,
                    "sourceBytes": str(source["bytes"]),
                    "sourceSHA256": str(source["sha256"]),
                    "commandSHA256": str(job["argvNULSHA256"]), "exit": "0",
                    "stdoutBytes": str(len(ast_raw)),
                    "stdoutSHA256": sha(ast_raw), "stderrBytes": "0",
                    "stderrSHA256": sha(b""), "validJSON": "yes",
                    "jsonKind": "dict",
                })

    if (
        len(writer.commands) != 95 or len(writer.jobs) != 86
        or len(writer.artifacts) != 299 or len(writer.progress) != 86
    ):
        raise AssertionError("successful finalize topology arithmetic")
    writer.ledger.write_bytes(b"".join(
        canonical_json(row) + b"\n" for row in writer.commands
    ))
    writer.progress_path.write_bytes(writer._progress_payload())
    _activate_snapshots(repo, output, Path(__file__).resolve(strict=True).parent)
    authority_lease = AuthorityDirectoryLease.acquire(
        repo, output, output / "corpus",
    )
    writer.authority_lease = authority_lease
    try:
        compile_inputs = compile_input_vector(writer.configs)
        writer.finalize(final_paths[:35], descriptions, source_rows, compile_inputs)
        handoff = output / "corpus-handoff.json"
        if not handoff.exists():
            raise AssertionError("successful finalize did not publish PASS")
    finally:
        _deactivate_snapshots()
        authority_lease.close()


def self_probes() -> list[str]:
    results: list[str] = []
    if path_vector_digest(["Sources/X/A.swift"]) != (
        "ffaabab545b129f342ff3310d526a21e94da55ed4b0d5e9644915da54c1eaa71"
    ):
        raise AssertionError("path digest positive vector")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="p1b-producer-probes.") as text:
        base = Path(text).resolve(strict=True)
        repo, output = base / "repo", base / "output"
        repo.mkdir()
        output.mkdir()
        (repo / "Package.swift").write_text("// fixture\n")
        linked = base / "linked"
