        linked.symlink_to(output, target_is_directory=True)
        _expect("bad-root-relative", lambda: exact_root(Path("relative")), results)
        _expect("bad-root-symlink", lambda: exact_root(linked), results)
        _expect("duplicate-path", lambda: path_vector_digest(["a", "a"]), results)
        _expect("bad-path-spelling", lambda: path_vector_digest(["a/../b"]), results)
        _expect(
            "path-order-digest-drift",
            lambda: _reject(path_vector_digest(["b", "a"]) != path_vector_digest(["a", "b"])),
            results,
        )
        _expect("unknown-output-flag", lambda: remove_closed_flags(["-emit-future"]), results)
        _expect("unknown-scheduling-flag", lambda: remove_closed_flags(["-j11"]), results)
        swift_cache = output / "swift"
        clang_cache = output / "clang"
        valid = [
            "/x/swift-frontend", "-frontend", "-dump-ast", "-primary-file", "/r/a.swift",
            "-dump-ast-format", "json", "-module-name", "AgentLoopCore",
            "-target", "arm64-test", "-sdk", "/sdk", "-module-cache-path",
            str(swift_cache), "-Onone", "-D", "DEBUG", "-Xcc",
            "-fmodules-cache-path=" + str(clang_cache), "-o", "-",
        ]
        validate_frontend(valid, ["/r/a.swift"], output, "debug", "AgentLoopCore")
        _expect(
            "unknown-frontend-flag",
            lambda: validate_frontend(
                valid + ["-emit-future"], ["/r/a.swift"], output,
                "debug", "AgentLoopCore",
            ), results,
        )
        baseline = semantic_signature(valid, ["/r/a.swift"])
        _expect(
            "bad-primary-count",
            lambda: validate_frontend(
                valid + ["-primary-file", "/r/a.swift"], ["/r/a.swift"],
                output, "debug", "AgentLoopCore",
            ), results,
        )
        _expect(
            "module-drift",
            lambda: validate_frontend(
                ["Wrong" if item == "AgentLoopCore" else item for item in valid],
                ["/r/a.swift"], output, "debug", "AgentLoopCore",
            ), results,
        )
        for name, old, new in (
            ("sdk-drift", "/sdk", "/other-sdk"),
            ("target-drift", "arm64-test", "x86-test"),
        ):
            mutated = [new if item == old else item for item in valid]
            _expect(
                name,
                lambda mutated=mutated: _reject(
                    semantic_signature(mutated, ["/r/a.swift"]) != baseline
                ), results,
            )
        no_debug = list(valid)
        debug_index = no_debug.index("-D")
        del no_debug[debug_index:debug_index + 2]
        _expect(
            "debug-drift",
            lambda: validate_frontend(
                no_debug, ["/r/a.swift"], output, "debug", "AgentLoopCore"
            ), results,
        )
        workspace_cache = list(valid)
        workspace_cache[workspace_cache.index("-module-cache-path") + 1] = str(repo / ".build/cache")
        _expect(
            "workspace-cache",
            lambda: validate_frontend(
                workspace_cache, ["/r/a.swift"], output, "debug", "AgentLoopCore"
            ), results,

def _produce_with_authority_lease(
    repo: Path, inventory: Path, output: Path,
    authority_lease: AuthorityDirectoryLease,
) -> None:
    _activate_snapshots(repo, output, Path(__file__).resolve(strict=True).parent)
    inventory_bytes = snapshot_bytes(inventory)
    document = inventory_bytes.decode("utf-8")
    scanner_source = extract_framed_source(document, SCANNER_HEADING)
    producer_source = extract_framed_source(document, PRODUCER_HEADING)
    executed_source = snapshot_bytes(Path(__file__).resolve(strict=True))
    if producer_source != executed_source:
        raise ContractError("executed producer differs from normative bytes")
    entry_paths, final_paths = scanner_path_vectors(scanner_source)
    if file_sha(inventory) != sha(inventory_bytes):
        raise ContractError("inventory changed during bootstrap")
    writer = CorpusWriter(
        repo, inventory, output, Path(__file__).resolve(strict=True),
        sha(executed_source), sha(scanner_source), final_paths,
    )
    writer.prepare()
    authority_lease.add(output / "corpus")
    writer.authority_lease = authority_lease
    swiftc = exact_executable("swiftc", "/usr/bin/swiftc")
    swift = exact_executable("swift", "/usr/bin/swift")
    version_row, version_stdout = writer.run(
        "compiler-version", [swiftc, "--version"], "compiler-version"
    )
    version_stderr = output / str(version_row["stderr"]["relativePath"])
    if (
        version_row["exitCode"] != 0
        or version_stdout != EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDOUT
        or snapshot_bytes(version_stderr) != EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDERR
    ):
        raise ContractError("compiler version drift")

    descriptions: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    parsed_descriptions: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    bin_paths: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for config in CONFIGS:
        row, stdout = writer.run(
            "show-bin-path",
            [swift, "build", "-c", config, "--show-bin-path"],
            f"{config}.show-bin-path", config=config,
        )
        stderr = output / str(row["stderr"]["relativePath"])
        if row["exitCode"] != 0 or snapshot_bytes(stderr) != b"":
            raise ContractError("show-bin-path process failure")
        bin_path = validate_bin_path(repo, config, stdout)
        bin_paths[config] = bin_path
        live = bin_path / "description.json"
        require_regular(live)
        relative = f"provenance/descriptions/{config}.description.json"
        artifact = writer.snapshot(
            "swiftpm-description", relative, snapshot_bytes(live)
        )
        parsed = strict_json(
            snapshot_bytes(output / relative), dictionary=True,
        )
        assert isinstance(parsed, dict)
        descriptions[config] = {
            "livePath": str(live),
            "liveSHA256": file_sha(live),
            "artifact": artifact,
        }
        parsed_descriptions[config] = parsed

    dryruns: dict[tuple[str, str], list[list[str]]] = {}
    for config in CONFIGS:
        for target in TARGETS:
            CONTEXT.stage, CONTEXT.config, CONTEXT.target = (
                "derive-config-target", config, target
            )
            key, record = select_swift_record(parsed_descriptions[config], target)
            sources = enumerate_target_sources(repo, bin_paths[config], target)
            if record["sources"] != sources:
                raise ContractError("description/source equality or order drift")
            record_payload = canonical_json({"recordKey": key, "record": record}) + b"\n"
            record_artifact = writer.snapshot(
                "swift-command-record",
                f"provenance/records/{config}.{target}.record.json",
                record_payload,
            )
            base, removed, rewritten = transform_record(
                record, output, config, target
            )
            process_row, stdout = writer.run(
                "frontend-dryrun", base + ["-###"],
                f"{config}.{target}.dryrun", config=config, target=target,
            )
            stderr = output / str(process_row["stderr"]["relativePath"])
            if process_row["exitCode"] != 0 or snapshot_bytes(stderr) != b"":
                raise ContractError("frontend dry-run process failure")
            jobs = parse_dryrun(stdout, sources, output, config, target)
            dryruns[(config, target)] = jobs
            jobs_artifact = writer.snapshot(
                "frontend-dryrun-jobs",
                f"provenance/dryruns/{config}.{target}.jobs.json",
                canonical_json({
                    "schema": DRYRUN_SCHEMA,
                    "config": config,
                    "target": target,
                    "jobs": jobs,
                    "argvNULSHA256": [argv_sha(argv) for argv in jobs],
                }) + b"\n",
            )
            selected = selected_paths(final_paths, target)
            available = {
                str(Path(path).relative_to(repo))
                for path in sources if contained(repo, Path(path))
            }
            if not set(selected) <= available:
                raise ContractError("selected path/source closure")
            writer.configs.append({
                "config": config,
                "target": target,
                "recordKey": key,
                "recordArtifact": record_artifact,
                "recordSHA256": sha(canonical_json(record)),
                "sourceOrder": sources,
                "baseArgv": base,
                "baseArgvNULSHA256": argv_sha(base),
                "baseSemanticSignature": semantic_signature(base, sources),
                "removed": removed,
                "rewritten": rewritten,
                "dryrunArtifact": jobs_artifact,
                "dryrunPrimaryCount": len(jobs),
                "dryrunArgvNULSHA256": [argv_sha(argv) for argv in jobs],
                "selectedCount": len(selected),
            })
    if sum(len(value) for value in dryruns.values()) != EXPECTED_DRYRUN_PRIMARY_COUNT:
        raise ContractError("complete dry-run primary arithmetic")

    frozen_compile_inputs = compile_input_vector(writer.configs)
    frozen_sources = source_rows(repo, final_paths)
    source_by_path = {str(row["exactPath"]): row for row in frozen_sources}
    for config in CONFIGS:
        for target in TARGETS:
            config_row = next(
                row for row in writer.configs
                if row["config"] == config and row["target"] == target
            )
            sources = list(config_row["sourceOrder"])
            selected = set(selected_paths(final_paths, target))
            for argv in dryruns[(config, target)]:
                primary = singleton_value(argv, "-primary-file")
                exact_path = (
                    str(Path(primary).relative_to(repo))
                    if contained(repo, Path(primary)) else ""
                )
                if exact_path not in selected:
                    continue
                process_row, _ = writer.run(
                    "primary", argv, "unused", config=config, target=target,
                    exact_path=exact_path,
                )
                stdout_path = output / str(process_row["stdout"]["relativePath"])
                stderr_path = output / str(process_row["stderr"]["relativePath"])
                if (
                    process_row["exitCode"] != 0
                    or snapshot_bytes(stderr_path) != b""
                    or not snapshot_bytes(stdout_path)
                ):
                    raise ContractError("primary process evidence failure")
                parse_json_dictionary_isolated(stdout_path, str(repo / exact_path))
                source = source_by_path[exact_path]
                identifier = job_id(config, target, exact_path)
                job = {
                    "ordinal": len(writer.jobs),
                    "jobID": identifier,
                    "config": config,
                    "target": target,
                    "exactPath": exact_path,
                    "primarySource": primary,
                    "sourceBytes": source["bytes"],
                    "sourceSHA256": source["sha256"],
                    "argv": argv,
                    "argvNULSHA256": argv_sha(argv),
                    "semanticSignature": semantic_signature(argv, sources),
                    "commandOrdinal": process_row["ordinal"],
                    "stdout": process_row["stdout"],
                    "stderr": process_row["stderr"],
                    "exit": process_row["exit"],
                }
                writer.jobs.append(job)
                writer.append_progress({
                    "ordinal": str(job["ordinal"]),
                    "jobID": identifier,
                    "config": config,
                    "target": target,
                    "exactPath": exact_path,
                    "sourceBytes": str(source["bytes"]),
                    "sourceSHA256": str(source["sha256"]),
                    "commandSHA256": str(job["argvNULSHA256"]),
                    "exit": "0",
                    "stdoutBytes": str(len(snapshot_bytes(stdout_path))),
                    "stdoutSHA256": file_sha(stdout_path),
                    "stderrBytes": "0",
                    "stderrSHA256": sha(b""),
                    "validJSON": "yes",
                    "jsonKind": "dict",
                })
    writer.finalize(
        entry_paths, descriptions, frozen_sources, frozen_compile_inputs
    )


def produce(root: Path, inventory: Path, output_root: Path) -> None:
    repo, inventory, output = validate_inputs(root, inventory, output_root)
    authority_lease = AuthorityDirectoryLease.acquire(repo, output)
    try:
        _produce_with_authority_lease(
            repo, inventory, output, authority_lease,
        )
    finally:
        _deactivate_snapshots()
        authority_lease.close()


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.self_test:
        if any(value is not None for value in (args.root, args.inventory, args.output_root)):
            parser.error("--self-test accepts no production paths")
        print(json.dumps(
            {"status": "PASS", "probes": self_probes()},
            sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
        ))
        return 0
    if any(value is None for value in (args.root, args.inventory, args.output_root)):
        parser.error("production requires --root, --inventory, --output-root")
    produce(args.root, args.inventory, args.output_root)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except BaseException as error:
        print(json.dumps({
            "status": "FAIL",
            "stage": CONTEXT.stage,
            "config": CONTEXT.config,
            "target": CONTEXT.target,
            "exactPath": CONTEXT.exact_path,
            "category": type(error).__name__,
        }, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)

#### §9.1g-v Inline normative terminal AST corpus validator source

This complete independent source is normative. The freeze bootstrap checks its exact frame metadata, compiles it, and runs only its isolated `--self-test`; the implementation driver and preflight source gates never invoke it against the authoritative corpus. The one fresh unfiltered authoritative `RunTests` invocation contains the sole TestSuite terminal source gate that invokes §9.1g scanner `--final`; that scanner alone re-extracts these exact validator bytes into a fresh descriptor-held source root and invokes them exactly once. The validator alone exclusively publishes the new `corpus-validation-handoff.json`, returns its exit-zero canonical result to that same scanner, and no second real-corpus validator or final-scanner invocation may reuse the output root.

def _open_directory_from_root(path: Path) -> int:
    """Open an absolute direct directory one O_NOFOLLOW component at a time."""
    if not path.is_absolute() or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in path.parts[1:]):
        raise ContractError("directory anchor spelling")
    current = os.open("/", _DIRECTORY_OPEN_FLAGS)
    try:
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(os.fstat(current).st_mode):
            raise ContractError("filesystem root is not a directory")
        for component in path.parts[1:]:
            next_descriptor = os.open(
                component, _DIRECTORY_OPEN_FLAGS, dir_fd=current,
            )
            os.close(current)
            current = next_descriptor
            if not stat.S_ISDIR(os.fstat(current).st_mode):
                raise ContractError("directory anchor component is not a directory")
        return current
    except BaseException:
        os.close(current)
        raise

def _stat_identity(info: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]:
    return (
        info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_size,
        info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns,
    )


def _directory_identity(
    info: os.stat_result,
) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]:
    return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, 0, 0, 0)


def _snapshot_anchor(path: Path) -> Path:
    matches = [
        root for root in _SNAPSHOT_ROOTS
        if path != root and (root == path.parent or root in path.parents)
    ]
    return max(matches, key=lambda value: len(value.parts)) if matches else path.parent


def _open_snapshot(path: Path, anchor: Path | None = None) -> FileSnapshot:
    if not path.is_absolute():
        raise ContractError("snapshot path is relative")
    root = _snapshot_anchor(path) if anchor is None else anchor
    require_directory(root)
    try:
        parts = path.relative_to(root).parts
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ContractError("snapshot path escapes anchor") from error
    if not parts or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parts):
        raise ContractError("snapshot component closure")
    opened: list[int] = []
    try:
        current = _open_directory_from_root(root)
        opened.append(current)
        anchor_identity = _directory_identity(os.fstat(current))
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(anchor_identity[2]):
            raise ContractError("snapshot anchor is not a directory")
        for component in parts[:-1]:
            current = os.open(
                component, _DIRECTORY_OPEN_FLAGS,
                dir_fd=current,
            )
            opened.append(current)
            if not stat.S_ISDIR(os.fstat(current).st_mode):
                raise ContractError("snapshot parent is not a directory")
        descriptor = os.open(
            parts[-1], _REGULAR_OPEN_FLAGS, dir_fd=current,
        )
        opened.append(descriptor)
        before = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode):
            raise ContractError("snapshot is not a regular file")
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(descriptor, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        after = os.fstat(descriptor)
        raw = b"".join(chunks)
        identity = _stat_identity(before)
        if _stat_identity(after) != identity or len(raw) != before.st_size:
            raise ContractError("snapshot changed while reading")
        return FileSnapshot(path, root, raw, identity, anchor_identity)
    except OSError as error:
        raise ContractError("descriptor-anchored snapshot open failed") from error
    finally:
        for descriptor in reversed(opened):
            os.close(descriptor)


def snapshot_bytes(path: Path) -> bytes:
    if _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS is None:
        return _open_snapshot(path).raw
    retained = _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS.get(path)
    if retained is None:
        retained = _open_snapshot(path)
        _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS[path] = retained
    return retained.raw


def snapshot_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return snapshot_bytes(path).decode("utf-8")


def _activate_snapshots(*roots: Path) -> None:
    global _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS, _SNAPSHOT_ROOTS
    _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS = {}
    _SNAPSHOT_ROOTS = tuple(roots)


def _deactivate_snapshots() -> None:
    global _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS, _SNAPSHOT_ROOTS
    _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS = None
    _SNAPSHOT_ROOTS = ()


def _recheck_snapshot_identity(snapshot: FileSnapshot) -> None:
    # A second descriptor open checks pathname identity but content is never
    # consumed again.  All parsing continues to use snapshot.raw.
    root = snapshot.anchor
    parts = snapshot.path.relative_to(root).parts
    opened: list[int] = []
    try:
        current = _open_directory_from_root(root)
        opened.append(current)
        if _directory_identity(os.fstat(current)) != snapshot.anchor_identity:
            raise ContractError("snapshot anchor identity drift")
        for component in parts[:-1]:
            current = os.open(
                component, _DIRECTORY_OPEN_FLAGS,
                dir_fd=current,
            )
            opened.append(current)
        descriptor = os.open(
            parts[-1], _REGULAR_OPEN_FLAGS, dir_fd=current,
        )
        opened.append(descriptor)
        identity = _stat_identity(os.fstat(descriptor))
    except OSError as error:
        raise ContractError("descriptor-anchored snapshot recheck failed") from error
    finally:
        for descriptor in reversed(opened):
            os.close(descriptor)
    if identity != snapshot.identity:
        raise ContractError("snapshot pathname identity drift")


def recheck_all_snapshot_identities() -> None:
    if _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS is None:
        return
    for snapshot in _ACTIVE_SNAPSHOTS.values():
        _recheck_snapshot_identity(snapshot)


def file_sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha(snapshot_bytes(path))


def canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
    try:
        return json.dumps(
            value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False,
        ).encode()
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ContractError("noncanonical JSON value") from error


def _reject_json_constant(value: str) -> object:
    raise ContractError("non-finite JSON constant")


def strict_json(raw: bytes, *, dictionary: bool = False) -> object:
    def closed_pairs(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
        result: dict[str, object] = {}
        for key, value in pairs:
            if key in result:
                raise ContractError("duplicate JSON key")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    value = json.loads(
        raw, object_pairs_hook=closed_pairs,
        parse_constant=_reject_json_constant,
    )
    if dictionary and not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ContractError("JSON value is not a dictionary")
    return value


def argv_sha(argv: list[str]) -> str:
    if not argv or any(not isinstance(item, str) or "\0" in item for item in argv):
        raise ContractError("invalid argv")
    return sha(ARGV_DOMAIN + b"\0".join(item.encode() for item in argv))


def validate_exact_path(path: str) -> None:
    if (
        not path or not path.isascii() or "\0" in path or "\\" in path
        or path.startswith("/") or path.endswith("/")
    ):
        raise ContractError("invalid exact path spelling")
    pieces = path.split("/")
    if any(not piece or piece in {".", ".."} for piece in pieces):
        raise ContractError("invalid exact path component")


def path_vector_digest(paths: list[str]) -> str:
    if not paths or len(paths) != len(set(paths)):
        raise ContractError("invalid exact path vector closure")
    for path in paths:
        validate_exact_path(path)
    count = str(len(paths))
    if count.startswith("0"):
        raise ContractError("non-canonical decimal count")
    # Frozen formula: SHA256(UTF8("P1BExactPathVectorV2") || NUL ||
    # UTF8(decimalCount) || NUL || concat(UTF8(path_i) || NUL)).
    return sha(PATH_DOMAIN + count.encode("ascii") + b"\0" + b"".join(
        path.encode("utf-8") + b"\0" for path in paths
    ))


def source_vector_digest(rows: list[dict[str, object]]) -> str:
    serial = SOURCE_VECTOR_DOMAIN + str(len(rows)).encode("ascii") + b"\0"
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"exactPath", "bytes", "sha256"}:
            raise ContractError("source vector row schema")
        path = row.get("exactPath"); size = row.get("bytes"); digest = row.get("sha256")
        if (
            not isinstance(path, str) or type(size) is not int or size < 0
            or not isinstance(digest, str)
            or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest) is None
        ):
            raise ContractError("source vector row type")
        validate_exact_path(path)
        serial += (
            path.encode() + b"\0" + str(size).encode("ascii") + b"\0"
            + digest.encode("ascii") + b"\0"
        )
    return sha(serial)


def compile_input_vector_digest(rows: list[dict[str, object]]) -> str:
    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_COMPILE_INPUT_COUNT:
        raise ContractError("compile input vector count")
    serial = COMPILE_INPUT_VECTOR_DOMAIN + str(len(rows)).encode("ascii") + b"\0"
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(rows):
        if (
            not isinstance(row, dict)
            or set(row) != COMPILE_INPUT_FIELDS
            or row.get("ordinal") != ordinal
            or isinstance(row.get("ordinal"), bool)
        ):
            raise ContractError("compile input vector schema/order")
        config = row.get("config")
        target = row.get("target")
        operand = row.get("sourceOperand")
        size = row.get("bytes")
        digest = row.get("sha256")
        if (
            not isinstance(config, str) or config not in CONFIGS
            or not isinstance(target, str) or target not in TARGETS
            or not isinstance(operand, str) or not operand or "\0" in operand
            or not Path(operand).is_absolute()
            or str(Path(operand)) != operand
            or not isinstance(size, int) or isinstance(size, bool) or size < 0
            or not isinstance(digest, str)
            or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest) is None
        ):
            raise ContractError("compile input vector row type")
        key = (config, target, operand)
        if key in seen:
            raise ContractError("compile input vector duplicate")
        seen.add(key)
        serial += canonical_json(row) + b"\0"
    return sha(serial)


def artifact_index_digest(rows: list[dict[str, object]]) -> str:
    if not rows:
        raise ContractError("empty artifact index")
    serial = ARTIFACT_INDEX_DOMAIN + str(len(rows)).encode("ascii") + b"\0"
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(rows):
        if (
            not isinstance(row, dict) or type(row.get("ordinal")) is not int
            or row.get("ordinal") != ordinal
        ):
            raise ContractError("artifact index order")
        serial += canonical_json(row) + b"\0"
    return sha(serial)


def job_id(config: str, target: str, exact_path: str) -> str:
    if config not in CONFIGS or target not in TARGETS:
        raise ContractError("invalid job config/target")
    validate_exact_path(exact_path)
    return sha(
        JOB_DOMAIN + config.encode() + b"\0" + target.encode() + b"\0"
        + exact_path.encode()
    )


def require_regular(path: Path) -> None:
    info = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or path.is_symlink():
        raise ContractError("not a direct regular file")


def require_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    info = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or path.is_symlink():
        raise ContractError("not a direct directory")


def contained(root: Path, child: Path) -> bool:
    try:
        child.relative_to(root)
        return child != root
    except ValueError:
        return False


def exact_root(path: Path) -> Path:
    if not path.is_absolute():
        raise ContractError("root is relative")
    require_directory(path)
    if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
        raise ContractError("root spelling or symlink drift")
    return path


def safe_relative(path: str) -> None:
    validate_exact_path(path)
    pure = PurePosixPath(path)
    if not path or pure.is_absolute() or ".." in pure.parts or "." in pure.parts:
        raise ContractError("unsafe relative artifact path")


def write_atomic(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
    require_directory(path.parent)
    dir_fd = _open_directory_from_root(path.parent)
    temporary = path.name + ".tmp"
    descriptor = -1
    try:
        descriptor = os.open(
            temporary,
            os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | _O_NOFOLLOW | _O_CLOEXEC,
            0o600, dir_fd=dir_fd,
        )
        view = memoryview(data)
        while view:
            written = os.write(descriptor, view)
            if written <= 0:
                raise ContractError("short atomic write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(descriptor)
        os.close(descriptor)
        descriptor = -1
        os.rename(temporary, path.name, src_dir_fd=dir_fd, dst_dir_fd=dir_fd)
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
    finally:
        if descriptor >= 0:
            os.close(descriptor)
        os.close(dir_fd)


def write_atomic_exclusive(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
    """Publish with descriptor-anchored renameatx_np(RENAME_EXCL)."""
    require_directory(path.parent)
    if sys.platform != "darwin":
        raise ContractError("renameatx_np(RENAME_EXCL) requires Darwin")
    dir_fd = _open_directory_from_root(path.parent)
    temporary = path.name + ".tmp"
    descriptor = -1
    try:
        descriptor = os.open(
            temporary,
            os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | _O_NOFOLLOW | _O_CLOEXEC,
            0o600, dir_fd=dir_fd,
        )
        view = memoryview(data)
        while view:
            written = os.write(descriptor, view)
            if written <= 0:
                raise ContractError("short exclusive publication write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(descriptor)
        os.close(descriptor)
        descriptor = -1
        libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
        try:
            renameatx_np = libc.renameatx_np
        except AttributeError as error:
            raise ContractError("renameatx_np unavailable") from error
        renameatx_np.argtypes = [
            ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p,
            ctypes.c_uint,
        ]
        renameatx_np.restype = ctypes.c_int
        rename_excl = 0x00000004
        result = renameatx_np(
            dir_fd, os.fsencode(temporary), dir_fd, os.fsencode(path.name),
            rename_excl,
        )
        if result != 0:
            failure = ctypes.get_errno()
            if failure == errno.EEXIST:
                raise ContractError("exclusive PASS publication already exists")
            raise ContractError(
                f"exclusive PASS publication failed errno={failure}"
            )
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
    finally:
        if descriptor >= 0:
            os.close(descriptor)
        os.close(dir_fd)


def walk_regular_tree(root: Path, anchor: Path) -> tuple[set[str], set[str]]:
    """Return direct regular files and directories, relative to anchor."""
    require_directory(root)
    require_directory(anchor)
    files: set[str] = set()
    directories: set[str] = {root.relative_to(anchor).as_posix()}
    stack = [root]
    while stack:
        directory = stack.pop()
        for item in os.scandir(directory):
            path = Path(item.path)
            if item.is_symlink():
                raise ContractError("symlink in terminal output")
            if item.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                require_directory(path)
                if path.resolve(strict=True) != path or not contained(anchor, path):
                    raise ContractError("terminal output directory containment drift")
                relative = path.relative_to(anchor).as_posix()
                safe_relative(relative)
                directories.add(relative)
                stack.append(path)
                continue
            if not item.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
                raise ContractError("special file in terminal output")
            require_regular(path)
            if path.resolve(strict=True) != path or not contained(anchor, path):
                raise ContractError("terminal output file containment drift")
            relative = path.relative_to(anchor).as_posix()
            safe_relative(relative)
            files.add(relative)
    return files, directories


def walk_regular_paths(root: Path, anchor: Path) -> set[str]:
    return walk_regular_tree(root, anchor)[0]


def require_evidence_tree_closure(output: Path, expected_files: set[str]) -> None:
    actual_files: set[str] = set()
    actual_directories: set[str] = set()
    for relative in ("corpus", "provenance"):
        files, directories = walk_regular_tree(output / relative, output)
        actual_files.update(files)
        actual_directories.update(directories)
    expected_directories = {"corpus", "provenance"}
    for relative in expected_files:
        safe_relative(relative)
        if not relative.startswith(("corpus/", "provenance/")):
            raise ContractError("evidence file outside closed roots")
        parent = PurePosixPath(relative).parent
        while parent.as_posix() not in {".", ""}:
            expected_directories.add(parent.as_posix())
            parent = parent.parent
    require_exact_set(
        actual_files, expected_files, "artifact index physical closure"
    )
    require_exact_set(
        actual_directories, expected_directories,
        "artifact directory topology closure",
    )


def require_exact_set(actual: set[str], expected: set[str], label: str) -> None:
    if actual != expected:
        raise ContractError(label)


def require_process_evidence(
    exit_path: Path, stderr_path: Path, expected_stderr: bytes = b""
) -> None:
    require_regular(exit_path)
    require_regular(stderr_path)
    if snapshot_bytes(exit_path) != b"0\n":
        raise ContractError("command exit evidence")
    if snapshot_bytes(stderr_path) != expected_stderr:
        raise ContractError("command stderr evidence")


def require_file_snapshot(path: Path, expected_bytes: int, expected_sha: str) -> None:
    require_regular(path)
    if (
        len(snapshot_bytes(path)) != expected_bytes
        or file_sha(path) != expected_sha
    ):
        raise ContractError("file snapshot drift")


def extract_framed_source(document: str, heading_fragment: str) -> bytes:
    headings = [
        line for line in document.splitlines()
        if line.startswith("#### ") and heading_fragment in line
    ]
    if len(headings) != 1:
        raise ContractError("framed heading closure")
    start = document.index(headings[0])
    opening = document.index("```tsv\n", start) + len("```tsv\n")
    closing = document.index("\n```", opening)
    framed = document[opening:closing + 1]
    meta_line, source = framed.split("\n", 1)
    if not meta_line.startswith("# meta\t"):
        raise ContractError("missing framed source metadata")
    try:
        meta = dict(
            field.split("=", 1)
            for field in meta_line.removeprefix("# meta\t").split("\t")
        )
    except Exception as error:
        raise ContractError("bad framed source metadata") from error
    raw = source.encode()
    actual = {
        "bytes": str(len(raw)),
        "lines": str(len(source.splitlines())),
        "sha256": sha(raw),
    }
    if meta != actual:
        raise ContractError("framed source metadata drift")
    compile(source, f"<embedded-{heading_fragment}>", "exec")
    return raw


def _literal_string_list(module: ast.Module, name: str) -> list[str]:
    values: list[ast.expr] = []
    for node in module.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
            isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == name
            for target in node.targets
        ):
            values.append(node.value)
        elif (
            isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign)
            and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name)
            and node.target.id == name
        ):
            values.append(node.value)
    if len(values) != 1:
        raise ContractError(f"{name} assignment closure")
    value = ast.literal_eval(values[0])
    if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in value):
        raise ContractError(f"{name} is not a literal string list")
    return value


def scanner_path_vectors(scanner_source: bytes) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    module = ast.parse(scanner_source.decode())
    entry = _literal_string_list(module, "ENTRY_PATHS")
    planned = _literal_string_list(module, "PLANNED_PATHS")
    final = entry + planned
    if len(entry) != 35 or len(planned) != 8 or len(final) != 43:
        raise ContractError("Revision03 path cardinality drift")
    if path_vector_digest(entry) != EXPECTED_ENTRY_PATH_DIGEST:
        raise ContractError("entry path digest drift")
    if path_vector_digest(final) != EXPECTED_FINAL_PATH_DIGEST:
        raise ContractError("terminal path digest drift")
    by_target = {
        target: [path for path in final if path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")]
        for target in TARGETS
    }
    if {key: len(value) for key, value in by_target.items()} != EXPECTED_SELECTED_COUNTS:
        raise ContractError("terminal target/path arithmetic")
    if set().union(*map(set, by_target.values())) != set(final):
        raise ContractError("terminal path target closure")
    return entry, final


def scan_swift_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    require_directory(root)
    result: list[Path] = []
    stack = [root]
    while stack:
        directory = stack.pop()
        entries = sorted(os.scandir(directory), key=lambda item: os.fsencode(item.name))
        children: list[Path] = []
        for item in entries:
            path = Path(item.path)
            if item.is_symlink():
                raise ContractError("symlink in target source tree")
            if item.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                children.append(path)
            elif item.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
                if item.name.endswith(".swift"):
                    require_regular(path)
                    if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
                        raise ContractError("source realpath drift")
                    result.append(path)
            else:
                raise ContractError("special file in target source tree")
        stack.extend(reversed(children))
    return sorted(result, key=lambda path: os.fsencode(str(path)))


def enumerate_target_sources(repo: Path, bin_path: Path, target: str) -> list[str]:
    if target not in TARGETS:
        raise ContractError("unknown target")
    sources = scan_swift_files(repo / "Sources" / target)
    if target == "AgentLoopApp":
        derived = (
            bin_path / "AgentLoopApp.build" / "DerivedSources"
            / "resource_bundle_accessor.swift"
        )
        require_regular(derived)
        if derived.resolve(strict=True) != derived:
            raise ContractError("derived source realpath drift")
        sources.append(derived)
    values = [str(path) for path in sources]
    if len(values) != EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNTS[target] or len(values) != len(set(values)):
        raise ContractError("target source count/uniqueness drift")
    return values


def select_swift_record(
    description: dict[str, object], target: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, object]]:
    commands = description.get("swiftCommands")
    if not isinstance(commands, dict):
        raise ContractError("description swiftCommands schema")
    matches = [
        (key, value)
        for key, value in commands.items()
        if isinstance(key, str)
        and isinstance(value, dict)
        and value.get("moduleName") == target
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ContractError("swiftCommands record closure")
    key, record = matches[0]
    required = {
        "executable", "importPath", "moduleName", "otherArguments", "sources"
    }
    if not required <= set(record):
        raise ContractError("swiftCommands required field closure")
    return key, record


REMOVALS: dict[str, int] = {
    "-incremental": 0,
    "-enable-batch-mode": 0,
    "-serialize-diagnostics": 0,
    "-parseable-output": 0,
    "-whole-module-optimization": 0,
    "-emit-objc-header": 0,
    "-index-store-path": 1,
    "-num-threads": 1,
    "-emit-objc-header-path": 1,
}
OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES = (
    "-emit-", "-index-", "-serialize-diagnostics", "-save-temps",
    "-driver-batch", "-num-threads", "-whole-module-optimization",
)


def remove_closed_flags(arguments: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]]]:
    retained: list[str] = []
    removed: list[list[str]] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(arguments):
        token = arguments[index]
        if token in REMOVALS:
            width = REMOVALS[token]
            if index + width >= len(arguments):
                raise ContractError("missing removed-flag operand")
            removed.append(arguments[index:index + width + 1])
            index += width + 1
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r"-j[0-9]+", token):
            if token != "-j10":
                raise ContractError("unknown scheduling flag")
            removed.append([token])
            index += 1
            continue
        if token.startswith(OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES):
            raise ContractError("unknown output/scheduling flag")
        retained.append(token)
        index += 1
    return retained, removed


def singleton_value(argv: list[str], flag: str) -> str:
    positions = [index for index, token in enumerate(argv) if token == flag]
    if len(positions) != 1 or positions[0] + 1 >= len(argv):
        raise ContractError(f"{flag} singleton")
    return argv[positions[0] + 1]


def _pairs(argv: list[str], flags: set[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    return [
        [token, argv[index + 1]]
        for index, token in enumerate(argv[:-1])
        if token in flags
    ]


def _conditionals(argv: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    rows: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(argv):
        token = argv[index]
        if token == "-D":
            if index + 1 >= len(argv):
                raise ContractError("dangling -D")
            rows.append(argv[index + 1])
            index += 2
        elif token.startswith("-D") and len(token) > 2:
            rows.append(token[2:])
            index += 1
        else:
            index += 1
    return rows


def semantic_signature(argv: list[str], sources: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    source_set = set(sources)
    return {
        "module": singleton_value(argv, "-module-name"),
        "target": singleton_value(argv, "-target"),
        "sdk": singleton_value(argv, "-sdk"),
        "optimization": [
            token for token in argv
            if token in {"-Onone", "-O", "-Osize", "-Ounchecked"}
        ],
        "conditionals": _conditionals(argv),
        "imports": _pairs(argv, {"-I", "-F", "-L", "-vfsoverlay"}),
        "plugins": _pairs(argv, {
            "-plugin-path", "-external-plugin-path",
            "-in-process-plugin-server-path", "-load-plugin-executable",
            "-load-plugin-library",
        }),
        "xcc": [
            argv[index + 1]
            for index, token in enumerate(argv[:-1]) if token == "-Xcc"
        ],
        "sourceOrder": [token for token in argv if token in source_set],
        "parseAsLibraryCount": argv.count("-parse-as-library"),
        "xfrontend": _pairs(argv, {"-Xfrontend"}),
    }


def transform_record(
    record: dict[str, object], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]], list[list[str]]]:
    executable = record.get("executable")
    module = record.get("moduleName")
    import_path = record.get("importPath")
    sources = record.get("sources")
    arguments = record.get("otherArguments")
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in (executable, module, import_path)):
        raise ContractError("driver record scalar schema")
    if module != target or not isinstance(sources, list) or not all(
        isinstance(item, str) for item in sources
    ):
        raise ContractError("driver record source schema")
    if not isinstance(arguments, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in arguments):
        raise ContractError("driver record argument schema")
    retained, removed = remove_closed_flags(arguments)
    positions = [index for index, token in enumerate(retained) if token == "-module-cache-path"]
    if len(positions) != 1 or positions[0] + 1 >= len(retained):
        raise ContractError("Swift module-cache closure")
    swift_index = positions[0] + 1
    old_swift = retained[swift_index]
    new_swift = str(output / "cache" / config / target / "swift")
    retained[swift_index] = new_swift
    xcc_cache = [
        index + 1 for index, token in enumerate(retained[:-1])
        if token == "-Xcc" and retained[index + 1].startswith("-fmodules-cache-path=")
    ]
    if len(xcc_cache) > 1:
        raise ContractError("Clang module-cache closure")
    new_clang = str(output / "cache" / config / target / "clang")
    rewrites = [["-module-cache-path", old_swift, new_swift]]
    if xcc_cache:
        position = xcc_cache[0]
        old_clang = retained[position].split("=", 1)[1]
        retained[position] = "-fmodules-cache-path=" + new_clang
        rewrites.append(["-fmodules-cache-path", old_clang, new_clang])
    else:
        retained.extend(["-Xcc", "-fmodules-cache-path=" + new_clang])
        rewrites.append(["-fmodules-cache-path", "ABSENT", new_clang])
    command = [
        executable, "-typecheck", "-dump-ast", "-dump-ast-format", "json",
        "-module-name", module, "-I", import_path, *sources, *retained,
    ]
    validate_base(command, list(sources), output, config, target)
    return command, removed, rewrites


def _validate_caches(signature: dict[str, object], argv: list[str], output: Path) -> None:
    if not contained(output, Path(singleton_value(argv, "-module-cache-path"))):
        raise ContractError("Swift cache containment")
    clang = [
        str(value).split("=", 1)[1]
        for value in signature["xcc"]  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        if str(value).startswith("-fmodules-cache-path=")
    ]
    if len(clang) != 1 or not contained(output, Path(clang[0])):
        raise ContractError("Clang cache containment")


def validate_base(
    argv: list[str], sources: list[str], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> None:
    prefix = [
        argv[0], "-typecheck", "-dump-ast", "-dump-ast-format", "json",
        "-module-name", target,
    ]
    if argv[:len(prefix)] != prefix:
        raise ContractError("base command prefix")
    signature = semantic_signature(argv, sources)
    if signature["sourceOrder"] != sources or signature["module"] != target:
        raise ContractError("base source/module drift")
    if ("DEBUG" in signature["conditionals"]) != (config == "debug"):
        raise ContractError("base DEBUG drift")
    if any(token.startswith(OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES) for token in argv):
        raise ContractError("base output/scheduling residue")
    _validate_caches(signature, argv, output)


def validate_frontend(
    argv: list[str], sources: list[str], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> None:
    if (
        len(argv) < 8 or not argv[0].endswith("/swift-frontend")
        or argv[1:3] != ["-frontend", "-dump-ast"]
    ):
        raise ContractError("frontend prefix")
    if argv.count("-primary-file") != 1:
        raise ContractError("frontend primary count")
    primary = singleton_value(argv, "-primary-file")
    if primary not in sources:
        raise ContractError("frontend primary source")
    if singleton_value(argv, "-dump-ast-format") != "json":
        raise ContractError("frontend AST JSON mode")
    if singleton_value(argv, "-o") != "-":
        raise ContractError("frontend stdout routing")
    forbidden = {
        "-emit-module", "-emit-object", "-emit-module-path",
        "-index-store-path", "-serialize-diagnostics",
        "-serialize-diagnostics-path", "-incremental", "-enable-batch-mode",
        "-parseable-output",
    }
    if forbidden.intersection(argv):
        raise ContractError("mutating frontend output flag")
    if (
        any(token.startswith(OUTPUT_OR_SCHEDULING_PREFIXES) for token in argv)
        or any(re.fullmatch(r"-j[0-9]+", token) for token in argv)
    ):
        raise ContractError("unknown frontend output/scheduling flag")
    signature = semantic_signature(argv, sources)
    if signature["sourceOrder"] != sources or signature["module"] != target:
        raise ContractError("frontend source/module drift")
    if ("DEBUG" in signature["conditionals"]) != (config == "debug"):
        raise ContractError("frontend DEBUG drift")
    _validate_caches(signature, argv, output)


def parse_dryrun(
    stdout: bytes, sources: list[str], output: Path, config: str, target: str
) -> list[list[str]]:
    try:
        lines = stdout.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
        raise ContractError("dry-run stdout encoding") from error
    if not lines or any(not line for line in lines):
        raise ContractError("dry-run line closure")
    jobs: list[list[str]] = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            argv = shlex.split(line, posix=True)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ContractError("dry-run command quoting") from error
        validate_frontend(argv, sources, output, config, target)
        jobs.append(argv)
    primaries = [singleton_value(argv, "-primary-file") for argv in jobs]
    if primaries != sources:
        raise ContractError("dry-run primary closure/order")
    return jobs


def target_for_exact_path(path: str) -> str:
    validate_exact_path(path)
    matches = [
        target for target in TARGETS if path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ContractError("exact path target closure")
    return matches[0]

@dataclass
class FailureContext:
    stage: str = "bootstrap"
    config: str = ""
    target: str = ""
    exact_path: str = ""


CONTEXT = FailureContext()


def _json_worker(send: object, raw: bytes, expected_filename: str) -> None:
    connection = send
    try:
        value = strict_json(raw, dictionary=True)
        ok = isinstance(value, dict)
        if expected_filename:
            ok = ok and (
                value.get("_kind") == "source_file"
                and value.get("filename") == expected_filename
                and value.get("compiler_version") == AST_COMPILER_VERSION
                and isinstance(value.get("items"), list)
            )
        connection.send({"ok": ok, "kind": type(value).__name__})
    except BaseException as error:
        connection.send({"ok": False, "kind": type(error).__name__})
    finally:
        connection.close()


def parse_json_dictionary_isolated(path: Path, expected_filename: str = "") -> None:
    raw = snapshot_bytes(path)
    context = multiprocessing.get_context("fork")
    receive, send = context.Pipe(duplex=False)
    process = context.Process(
        target=_json_worker, args=(send, raw, expected_filename)
    )
    process.start()
    send.close()
    try:
        payload = receive.recv()
    except EOFError as error:
        process.join()
        raise ContractError("JSON worker exited without evidence") from error
    finally:
        receive.close()
    process.join()
    if (
        process.exitcode != 0 or not isinstance(payload, dict)
        or payload.get("ok") is not True or payload.get("kind") != "dict"
    ):
        raise ContractError("AST is not a fully parseable JSON dictionary")


def load_json_dictionary(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    raw = snapshot_bytes(path)
    value = strict_json(raw, dictionary=True)
    assert isinstance(value, dict)
    if raw != canonical_json(value) + b"\n":
        raise ContractError("JSON authority is not canonical JSON plus LF")
    return value


def binding(output: Path, value: object, expected_path: str) -> Path:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"path", "bytes", "sha256"}:
        raise ContractError("file binding schema")
    if value["path"] != expected_path:
        raise ContractError("file binding path")
    safe_relative(expected_path)
    path = output / expected_path
    raw = snapshot_bytes(path)
    if (
        not isinstance(value["bytes"], int)
        or isinstance(value["bytes"], bool)
        or value["bytes"] < 0
        or not isinstance(value["sha256"], str)
        or value["bytes"] != len(raw)
        or value["sha256"] != sha(raw)
    ):
        raise ContractError("file binding snapshot drift")
    return path


def environment(output: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    values = dict(os.environ)
    values.update({
        "LC_ALL": "C", "LANG": "C", "TZ": "UTC",
        "TMPDIR": str(output / "tmp"),
        "SWIFT_MODULECACHE_PATH": str(output / "cache" / "environment-swift"),
        "CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH": str(output / "cache" / "environment-clang"),
    })
    return values


def _runtime_directory_identity(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]:
    descriptor = _open_directory_from_root(path)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
            raise ContractError("runtime descriptor is not directory")
        return _directory_identity(info)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def validate_runtime_directories(
    output: Path,
    expected: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]] | None = None,
) -> dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]]:
    """Validate non-authority cache/TMPDIR topology at process boundaries."""
    require_directory(output)
    observed: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]] = {}
    for leaf in ("cache", "tmp"):
        root = output / leaf
        require_directory(root)
        if root.resolve(strict=True) != root or not contained(output, root):
            raise ContractError("runtime root containment drift")
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            directory = stack.pop()
            require_directory(directory)
            observed[directory] = _runtime_directory_identity(directory)
            if directory != root and not contained(root, directory):
                raise ContractError("runtime directory escape")
            for item in os.scandir(directory):
                path = Path(item.path)
                if item.is_symlink():
                    raise ContractError("symlink in runtime directory")
                if item.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                    require_directory(path)
                    if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
                        raise ContractError("runtime directory resolution drift")
                    stack.append(path)
                elif not item.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
                    raise ContractError("special runtime directory entry")
    if expected is not None and any(
        observed.get(path) != identity for path, identity in expected.items()
    ):
        raise ContractError("runtime directory identity changed across subprocess")
    return observed


@dataclass
class RuntimeDirectoryLease:
    descriptors: dict[Path, int]
    identities: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]]

    def verify(self, output: Path) -> None:
        validate_runtime_directories(output, {
            path: identity for path, identity in self.identities.items()
            if path == output / "cache" or path == output / "tmp"
            or output / "cache" in path.parents or output / "tmp" in path.parents
        })
        for path, descriptor in self.descriptors.items():
            if _directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor)) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("held runtime directory descriptor drift")
            if _runtime_directory_identity(path) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("runtime directory pathname replacement")

    def close(self) -> None:
        for descriptor in self.descriptors.values():
            os.close(descriptor)
        self.descriptors.clear()


@dataclass
class AuthorityDirectoryLease:
    descriptors: dict[Path, int]
    identities: dict[Path, tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int]]

    @classmethod
    def acquire(cls, *paths: Path) -> "AuthorityDirectoryLease":
        lease = cls({}, {})
        try:
            for path in paths:
                lease.add(path)
            return lease
        except BaseException:
            lease.close()
            raise

    def add(self, path: Path) -> None:
        if path in self.descriptors:
            raise ContractError("duplicate authority directory anchor")
        require_directory(path)
        descriptor = _open_directory_from_root(path)
        identity = _directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor))
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(identity[2]):
            os.close(descriptor)
            raise ContractError("authority anchor is not directory")
        self.descriptors[path] = descriptor
        self.identities[path] = identity

    def verify(self) -> None:
        for path, descriptor in self.descriptors.items():
            if _directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor)) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("held authority directory descriptor drift")
            if _runtime_directory_identity(path) != self.identities[path]:
                raise ContractError("authority directory pathname replacement")

    def close(self) -> None:
        for descriptor in self.descriptors.values():
            os.close(descriptor)
        self.descriptors.clear()


def hold_runtime_directories(repo: Path, output: Path) -> RuntimeDirectoryLease:
    observed = validate_runtime_directories(output)
    for path in (repo, output):
        require_directory(path)
        observed[path] = _runtime_directory_identity(path)
    descriptors: dict[Path, int] = {}
    try:
        for path in observed:
            descriptors[path] = _open_directory_from_root(path)
        lease = RuntimeDirectoryLease(descriptors, observed)
        lease.verify(output)
        return lease
    except BaseException:
        for descriptor in descriptors.values():
            os.close(descriptor)
        raise


HANDOFF_FIELDS = {
    "schema", "status", "repositoryRoot", "outputRoot", "corpusRoot",
    "manifest", "inventorySHA256", "producerSHA256", "scannerSHA256",
    "finalPathDigest", "artifactManifestSHA256", "ledgerSHA256",
    "progressSHA256", "compileInputVector", "compileInputVectorDigest",
    "counts", "allSuccess",
}
MANIFEST_FIELDS = {
    "schema", "status", "repositoryRoot", "outputRoot", "corpusRoot",
    "inventory", "producer", "scanner", "compiler", "entryPaths",
    "entryPathDigest", "finalPaths", "finalPathDigest", "sourceVector",
    "sourceVectorDigest", "compileInputVector", "compileInputVectorDigest",
    "descriptions", "configs", "jobs", "counts", "ledger", "progress",
    "artifactManifest", "allSuccess",
}
EXPECTED_COUNTS = {
    "configTargetRecords": 6,
    "dryrunPrimaries": EXPECTED_DRYRUN_PRIMARY_COUNT,
    "compileInputs": EXPECTED_COMPILE_INPUT_COUNT,
    "selectedJobs": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
    "commands": EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT,
    "progress": EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT,
    "artifacts": EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT,
}


def require_expected_counts(value: object) -> None:
    if (
        not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != set(EXPECTED_COUNTS)
        or any(type(value[key]) is not int for key in EXPECTED_COUNTS)
        or value != EXPECTED_COUNTS
    ):
        raise ContractError("authority count type/value closure")
VALIDATION_HANDOFF_FIELDS = {
    "schema", "status", "repositoryRoot", "outputRoot", "corpusRoot",
    "producerManifest", "producerHandoff", "artifactManifest",
    "artifactIndexSHA256", "inventorySHA256", "producerSHA256",
    "validatorSHA256", "scannerSHA256", "entryPathDigest",
    "finalPathDigest", "compileInputVector", "compileInputVectorDigest",
    "astBindings", "counts", "allSuccess",
}
AST_BINDING_FIELDS = {
    "ordinal", "jobID", "config", "target", "exactPath", "relativePath",
    "bytes", "sha256",
}


def validate_inputs(
    root: Path, inventory: Path, corpus: Path
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, Path]:
    repo = exact_root(root)
    corpus = exact_root(corpus)
    if corpus.name != "corpus":
        raise ContractError("corpus leaf name")
    output = exact_root(corpus.parent)
    if repo == output or contained(repo, output) or contained(output, repo):
        raise ContractError("repository/output overlap")
    if not inventory.is_absolute():
        raise ContractError("inventory is relative")
    require_regular(inventory)
    if inventory.resolve(strict=True) != inventory or not contained(repo, inventory):
        raise ContractError("inventory is not a canonical repository file")
    return repo, inventory, corpus, output


def load_authority(
    repo: Path, inventory: Path, corpus: Path, output: Path
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], dict[str, object], bytes, bytes, list[str], list[str]]:
    handoff_path = output / "corpus-handoff.json"
    handoff = load_json_dictionary(handoff_path)
    if set(handoff) != HANDOFF_FIELDS:
        raise ContractError("handoff field closure")
    if handoff.get("schema") != HANDOFF_SCHEMA:
        raise ContractError("legacy/non-V2 corpus offered to final mode")
    if handoff.get("status") != "PASS" or handoff.get("allSuccess") is not True:
        raise ContractError("handoff is not PASS")
    manifest_path = binding(output, handoff.get("manifest"), "corpus-manifest.json")
    manifest = load_json_dictionary(manifest_path)
    if set(manifest) != MANIFEST_FIELDS:
        raise ContractError("manifest field closure")
    if manifest.get("schema") != CORPUS_SCHEMA:
        raise ContractError("manifest is not terminal V2")
    if manifest.get("status") != "PASS" or manifest.get("allSuccess") is not True:
        raise ContractError("manifest is not PASS")
    document = snapshot_text(inventory)
    scanner = extract_framed_source(document, SCANNER_HEADING)
    producer = extract_framed_source(document, PRODUCER_HEADING)
    validator = extract_framed_source(document, VALIDATOR_HEADING)
    if validator != snapshot_bytes(Path(__file__).resolve(strict=True)):
        raise ContractError("executed validator differs from normative bytes")
    entry_paths, final_paths = scanner_path_vectors(scanner)
    expected_roots = {
        "repositoryRoot": str(repo), "outputRoot": str(output),
        "corpusRoot": str(corpus),
    }
    if any(handoff.get(key) != value for key, value in expected_roots.items()):
        raise ContractError("handoff root binding")
    if any(manifest.get(key) != value for key, value in expected_roots.items()):
        raise ContractError("manifest root binding")
    if manifest.get("inventory") != {"path": str(inventory), "sha256": file_sha(inventory)}:
        raise ContractError("manifest inventory binding")
    if manifest.get("producer") != {"sha256": sha(producer)}:
        raise ContractError("manifest producer binding")
    if manifest.get("scanner") != {"sha256": sha(scanner)}:
        raise ContractError("manifest scanner binding")
    if (
        handoff.get("inventorySHA256") != file_sha(inventory)
        or handoff.get("producerSHA256") != sha(producer)
        or handoff.get("scannerSHA256") != sha(scanner)
    ):
        raise ContractError("handoff source binding")
    if (
        manifest.get("entryPaths") != entry_paths
        or manifest.get("finalPaths") != final_paths
        or manifest.get("entryPathDigest") != path_vector_digest(entry_paths)
        or manifest.get("finalPathDigest") != path_vector_digest(final_paths)
        or handoff.get("finalPathDigest") != path_vector_digest(final_paths)
    ):
        raise ContractError("path vector binding")
    compile_inputs = manifest.get("compileInputVector")
    if (
        not isinstance(compile_inputs, list)
        or manifest.get("compileInputVectorDigest")
        != compile_input_vector_digest(compile_inputs)
        or handoff.get("compileInputVector") != compile_inputs
        or handoff.get("compileInputVectorDigest")
        != manifest.get("compileInputVectorDigest")
    ):
        raise ContractError("compile input authority binding")
    require_expected_counts(manifest.get("counts"))
    require_expected_counts(handoff.get("counts"))
    return handoff, manifest, producer, scanner, entry_paths, final_paths


ARTIFACT_FIELDS = (
    "ordinal", "artifactID", "role", "relativePath", "fileType", "bytes",
    "sha256",
)
ARTIFACT_ROLES = {
    "process-stdout", "process-stderr", "process-exit",
    "swiftpm-description", "swift-command-record", "frontend-dryrun-jobs",
}


def artifact_binding(
    output: Path, value: object, rows: dict[str, dict[str, object]]
) -> Path:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != set(ARTIFACT_FIELDS):
        raise ContractError("embedded artifact binding schema")
    relative = value.get("relativePath")
    if not isinstance(relative, str) or rows.get(relative) != value:
        raise ContractError("embedded artifact binding mismatch")
    return output / relative


def validate_artifacts(
    output: Path, handoff: dict[str, object], manifest: dict[str, object]
) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    artifact_manifest = binding(
        output, manifest.get("artifactManifest"),
        "corpus-artifact-manifest.tsv",
    )
    ledger = binding(output, manifest.get("ledger"), "corpus-command-ledger.jsonl")
    progress = binding(output, manifest.get("progress"), "corpus-progress.tsv")
    if (
        handoff.get("artifactManifestSHA256") != file_sha(artifact_manifest)
        or handoff.get("ledgerSHA256") != file_sha(ledger)
        or handoff.get("progressSHA256") != file_sha(progress)
    ):
        raise ContractError("handoff top-level artifact hash")
    text = snapshot_text(artifact_manifest)
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter="\t")
    if tuple(reader.fieldnames or ()) != ARTIFACT_FIELDS:
        raise ContractError("artifact manifest header")
    raw_rows = list(reader)
    if len(raw_rows) != EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_COUNT:
        raise ContractError("artifact manifest count")
    rows: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for expected_ordinal, raw in enumerate(raw_rows):
        if set(raw) != set(ARTIFACT_FIELDS):
            raise ContractError("artifact row fields")
        try:
            ordinal = int(raw["ordinal"])
            size = int(raw["bytes"])
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ContractError("artifact numeric field") from error
        if str(ordinal) != raw["ordinal"] or str(size) != raw["bytes"]:
            raise ContractError("artifact noncanonical decimal")
        relative = raw["relativePath"]
        role = raw["role"]
        safe_relative(relative)
        if ordinal != expected_ordinal or role not in ARTIFACT_ROLES:
            raise ContractError("artifact ordinal/role")
        if raw["fileType"] != "regular" or relative in rows:
            raise ContractError("artifact type/duplicate")
        path = output / relative
        require_regular(path)
        expected_id = sha(
            b"P1BTerminalASTArtifactV2\0" + role.encode() + b"\0"
            + relative.encode()
        )
        if (
            path.resolve(strict=True) != path or not contained(output, path)
            or raw["artifactID"] != expected_id
        ):
            raise ContractError("artifact identity/hash/containment")
        require_file_snapshot(path, size, raw["sha256"])
        rows[relative] = {
            **raw, "ordinal": ordinal, "bytes": size,
        }
    if Counter(row["role"] for row in rows.values()) != Counter({
        "process-stdout": 95,
        "process-stderr": 95,
        "process-exit": 95,
        "swiftpm-description": 2,
        "swift-command-record": 6,
        "frontend-dryrun-jobs": 6,
    }):
        raise ContractError("artifact role arithmetic")
    require_evidence_tree_closure(output, set(rows))
    top_names = {item.name for item in os.scandir(output)}
    expected_top = {
        "corpus", "provenance", "cache", "tmp",
        "corpus-command-ledger.jsonl", "corpus-progress.tsv",
        "corpus-artifact-manifest.tsv", "corpus-manifest.json",
        "corpus-handoff.json",
    }
    validation_handoff = output / "corpus-validation-handoff.json"
    if validation_handoff.exists() or validation_handoff.is_symlink():
        require_regular(validation_handoff)
        if (
            validation_handoff.resolve(strict=True) != validation_handoff
            or not contained(output, validation_handoff)
        ):
            raise ContractError("validation handoff containment")
        expected_top.add("corpus-validation-handoff.json")
    require_exact_set(top_names, expected_top, "terminal output top-level closure")
    walk_regular_paths(output / "cache", output)
    walk_regular_paths(output / "tmp", output)
    authority = [
        output / "corpus-command-ledger.jsonl", output / "corpus-progress.tsv",
        output / "corpus-artifact-manifest.tsv", output / "corpus-manifest.json",
    ] + [output / relative for relative in rows]
    # Publication safety is byte/identity based.  mtimes are not authority:
    # capture every pathname once and recheck identities before PASS publish.
    snapshot_bytes(output / "corpus-handoff.json")
    for path in authority:
        snapshot_bytes(path)
    return rows


def require_artifact_role(
    output: Path, path: Path, artifacts: dict[str, dict[str, object]], role: str
) -> None:
    relative = str(path.relative_to(output))
    if artifacts.get(relative, {}).get("role") != role:
        raise ContractError("artifact role binding")


def validate_nonprocess_ownership(
    output: Path, manifest: dict[str, object],
    artifacts: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
) -> None:
    descriptions = manifest.get("descriptions")
    configs = manifest.get("configs")
    if not isinstance(descriptions, dict) or set(descriptions) != set(CONFIGS):
        raise ContractError("description ownership schema")
    if not isinstance(configs, list) or len(configs) != 6:
        raise ContractError("config ownership schema")
    expected_pairs = [
        (config, target) for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
    ]
    referenced: set[str] = set()

    def own(value: object, role: str, expected_relative: str) -> None:
        path = artifact_binding(output, value, artifacts)
        relative = path.relative_to(output).as_posix()
        if relative != expected_relative or relative in referenced:
            raise ContractError("nonprocess artifact path/owner drift")
        require_artifact_role(output, path, artifacts, role)
        referenced.add(relative)

    for config in CONFIGS:
        value = descriptions[config]
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {
            "livePath", "liveSHA256", "artifact",
        }:
            raise ContractError("description ownership fields")
        own(
            value["artifact"], "swiftpm-description",
            f"provenance/descriptions/{config}.description.json",
        )
    for index, (config, target) in enumerate(expected_pairs):
        row = configs[index]
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != CONFIG_FIELDS:
            raise ContractError("config ownership fields")
        if (row.get("config"), row.get("target")) != (config, target):
            raise ContractError("config ownership order")
        own(
            row["recordArtifact"], "swift-command-record",
            f"provenance/records/{config}.{target}.record.json",
        )
        own(
            row["dryrunArtifact"], "frontend-dryrun-jobs",
            f"provenance/dryruns/{config}.{target}.jobs.json",
        )
    expected = {
        relative for relative, row in artifacts.items()
        if not str(row["role"]).startswith("process-")
    }
    require_exact_set(
        referenced, expected, "nonprocess artifact ownership closure"
    )


COMMAND_FIELDS = {
    "schema", "ordinal", "stage", "config", "target", "exactPath",
    "argv", "argvNULSHA256", "exitCode", "stdout", "stderr", "exit",
}
PROGRESS_FIELDS = (
    "ordinal", "jobID", "config", "target", "exactPath", "sourceBytes",
    "sourceSHA256", "commandSHA256", "exit", "stdoutBytes", "stdoutSHA256",
    "stderrBytes", "stderrSHA256", "validJSON", "jsonKind",
)


def validate_ledger(
    output: Path, artifacts: dict[str, dict[str, object]]
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    raw_ledger = snapshot_bytes(output / "corpus-command-ledger.jsonl")
    if not raw_ledger.endswith(b"\n"):
        raise ContractError("command ledger final LF")
    lines = raw_ledger[:-1].split(b"\n")
    if len(lines) != EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT or any(not line for line in lines):
        raise ContractError("command ledger line closure")
    commands: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    referenced: set[str] = set()
    expected_stages = (
        ["compiler-version"] + ["show-bin-path"] * 2
        + ["frontend-dryrun"] * 6 + ["primary"] * 86
    )
    for ordinal, line in enumerate(lines):
        value = strict_json(line, dictionary=True)
        assert isinstance(value, dict)
        if line != canonical_json(value):
            raise ContractError("command ledger row is not canonical JSON")
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != COMMAND_FIELDS:
            raise ContractError("command row schema")
        if (
            value.get("schema") != COMMAND_SCHEMA
            or value.get("ordinal") != ordinal
            or isinstance(value.get("ordinal"), bool)
            or value.get("stage") != expected_stages[ordinal]
            or not isinstance(value.get("argv"), list)
            or value.get("argvNULSHA256") != argv_sha(value["argv"])
            or value.get("exitCode") != 0
            or isinstance(value.get("exitCode"), bool)
        ):
            raise ContractError("command row identity/status")
        if ordinal == 0:
            expected_metadata = ("", "", "")
        elif ordinal in {1, 2}:
            expected_metadata = (CONFIGS[ordinal - 1], "", "")
        elif 3 <= ordinal < 9:
            pair = [
                (config, target)
                for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
            ][ordinal - 3]
            expected_metadata = (pair[0], pair[1], "")
        else:
            expected_metadata = None
        if expected_metadata is not None and (
            value["config"], value["target"], value["exactPath"]
        ) != expected_metadata:
            raise ContractError("command metadata drift")
        if ordinal == 0:
            base = "provenance/commands/0000.compiler-version"
        elif ordinal in {1, 2}:
            config = CONFIGS[ordinal - 1]
            base = f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}.{config}.show-bin-path"
        elif 3 <= ordinal < 9:
            config, target = [
                (config, target)
                for config in CONFIGS for target in TARGETS
            ][ordinal - 3]
            base = (
                f"provenance/commands/{ordinal:04d}."
                f"{config}.{target}.dryrun"
            )
        else:
            config = value.get("config")
            target = value.get("target")
            exact_path = value.get("exactPath")
            if (
                config not in CONFIGS or target not in TARGETS
                or not isinstance(exact_path, str)
                or not exact_path.startswith(f"Sources/{target}/")
            ):
                raise ContractError("primary command metadata")
            base = f"corpus/{config}/{target}/{job_id(config, target, exact_path)}"
        expected_relatives = {
            "stdout": base + (
                ".ast.json" if value["stage"] == "primary" else ".stdout"
            ),
            "stderr": base + ".stderr",
            "exit": base + ".exit",
        }
        for key, role in (
            ("stdout", "process-stdout"), ("stderr", "process-stderr"),
            ("exit", "process-exit"),
        ):
            path = artifact_binding(output, value[key], artifacts)
            relative = str(path.relative_to(output))
            if (
                relative != expected_relatives[key] or relative in referenced
                or artifacts[relative]["role"] != role
            ):
                raise ContractError("command process artifact ownership")
            referenced.add(relative)
        exit_path = artifact_binding(output, value["exit"], artifacts)
        stderr_path = artifact_binding(output, value["stderr"], artifacts)
        expected_stderr = (
            EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDERR
            if value["stage"] == "compiler-version" else b""
        )
        require_process_evidence(exit_path, stderr_path, expected_stderr)
        if value["stage"] == "compiler-version":
            stdout_path = artifact_binding(output, value["stdout"], artifacts)
            if snapshot_bytes(stdout_path) != EXPECTED_SWIFTC_STDOUT:
                raise ContractError("compiler evidence drift")
        commands.append(value)
    if len(referenced) != 285:
        raise ContractError("process artifact reference closure")
    return commands


def validate_progress(output: Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    reader = csv.DictReader(
        io.StringIO(snapshot_text(output / "corpus-progress.tsv")), delimiter="\t"
    )
    if tuple(reader.fieldnames or ()) != PROGRESS_FIELDS:
        raise ContractError("progress header")
    rows = list(reader)
    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_SELECTED_JOB_COUNT:
        raise ContractError("progress row count")
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(rows):
        if set(row) != set(PROGRESS_FIELDS) or row["ordinal"] != str(ordinal):
            raise ContractError("progress row schema/ordinal")
        key = (row["config"], row["exactPath"])
        if key in seen:
            raise ContractError("duplicate progress key")
        seen.add(key)
        if (
            row["exit"] != "0" or row["stderrBytes"] != "0"
            or row["stderrSHA256"] != sha(b"")
            or row["validJSON"] != "yes" or row["jsonKind"] != "dict"
        ):
            raise ContractError("progress process evidence")
        for field in ("sourceBytes", "stdoutBytes"):
            try:
                value = int(row[field])
            except ValueError as error:
                raise ContractError("progress numeric field") from error
            if value <= 0 or str(value) != row[field]:
                raise ContractError("progress noncanonical numeric field")
    return rows


CONFIG_FIELDS = {
    "config", "target", "recordKey", "recordArtifact", "recordSHA256",
    "sourceOrder", "baseArgv", "baseArgvNULSHA256",
    "baseSemanticSignature", "removed", "rewritten", "dryrunArtifact",
    "dryrunPrimaryCount", "dryrunArgvNULSHA256", "selectedCount",
}


def exact_executable(name: str, expected: str) -> str:
    resolved = shutil.which(name)
    if resolved is None or str(Path(resolved).resolve(strict=True)) != expected:
        raise ContractError("tool executable drift")
    return expected


def validate_bin_path(repo: Path, config: str, stdout: bytes) -> Path:
    try:
        lines = stdout.decode().splitlines()
    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path encoding") from error
    if len(lines) != 1 or not lines[0]:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path cardinality")
    path = Path(lines[0])
    require_directory(path)
    if path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path realpath")
    try:
        pieces = path.relative_to(repo / ".build").parts
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path outside build root") from error
    if len(pieces) != 2 or pieces[1] != config or not pieces[0]:
        raise ContractError("show-bin-path shape")
